item.title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent.

Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously wit…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Whole-Route Planning of a Memory Bus Between Two BGAs: An Exact Model of Crossings and Layer Changes, Negotiated to DRC-Clean Copper
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Routing the bus between a processor and its DRAM remains largely manual in printed circuit board (PCB) design, and published algorithms optimize proxies such...

Routing the bus between a processor and its DRAM remains largely manual in printed circuit board (PCB) design, and published algorithms optimize proxies such as crossing or layer counts. We present a router that plans every lane of a two-layer BGA-to-BGA bus before any copper is laid, and carries the plan to design-rule-clean copper. Its core is an exact constraint-programming model that chooses, for all lanes at once, where each necessary crossing occurs, in what order -- by a rule over every triple of lanes -- and where each lane changes layer, with via room; for the ends it is given, it proves its plan optimal within the model. The model reads naturally as physics: worldlines, frustrated Ising spins and contact forces. A linear program places the lanes in millimeters; the constraints it must violate return to the model as cuts, and audit findings as negotiated congestion prices, until the plan passes an audit against the production router's rules or lays clean. The escapes are chosen by an estimate of the same objective, and differential pairs carry their polarity, with an automatic via crossover where the ends disagree. On an Allwinner H3 and a Zynq-7020, each to a DDR3 device,…

item.title: When and Why to Use TMA: A Workload-Grounded Characterization of Tensor Memory Acceleration on NVIDIA Hopper GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Hopper TMA 在生产 GPU kernel 中普遍但使用有选择性——同一 kernel 内有些张量用 TMA、有些退回 cp.async/直接全局加载/DSM，实践者面对"该不该用 TMA、用不用 cluster multicast"缺少依据。

方法 H100 上工作负载驱动的刻画：编目 FlashAttention-3 forward 内 TMA/multicast/DSM/cp.async 选择，用定向微基准（传输大小交叉、multicast 缩放）隔离判别特征，产出 Hopper 加载机制选择的经验法则；对比 TMA multicast 与 DSM 竞争广播原语；并扩展到 Blackwell SM100（B200 CUTLASS GEMM）。

关键数字 摘要未给出单一汇总数值；给出 TMA 何时划算、multicast 何时有助/有害的可预测指导，定性分发规则跨代延续、绝对交叉点随张量核与带宽缩放移动。

为什么值得看 专家 kernel 里 TMA 选择的系统刻画，写 Hopper/Blackwell kernel 的选型手册。

item.title: When Respondents Are Scarce: LLM-Derived Semantic Priors for Bayesian Confirmatory Factor Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Across social and behavioral research, measuring latent constructs can be challenging when target populations are small or difficult to reach.

Across social and behavioral research, measuring latent constructs can be challenging when target populations are small or difficult to reach. Recruiting additional respondents may be costly or infeasible, leaving researchers with limited data for estimating questionnaire factor structures. Yet item wording contains structural expectations before data collection, and whether these can improve small-sample estimation without replacing empirical validation remains unclear. We introduce the Semantic-Empirical Updating Framework (SEUF), which converts large language model paraphrases and embeddings, aligned with hypothesized item-factor assignments, into prespecified priors for Bayesian confirmatory factor analysis. We evaluated SEUF using a 38-item survey of 617 industrial-park stakeholders and two public surveys, FEVS and RIASEC. Semantic structure persisted after wording controls across all three instruments. With 50 respondents, SEUF achieved loading precision comparable to conventional CFA with 70-82 respondents, equivalent to 29-39% fewer respondents at the specified precision benchmark. Results showed lower loading errors and improved credible-interval coverage relative to conve…

item.title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools.

Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools. However, it remains unclear when fine-grained credit assignment improves learning and when it fails to improve task performance. Video editing provides a useful testbed for this question, combining multimodal perception, long-horizon planning, and tool use with delayed outcome feedback. We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessiv…

item.title: Waypoint: Analytically Modeling GEMM for CPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高性能 GEMM 实现依赖精心挑选的 tile 尺寸达到峰值性能，如何对给定硬件与输入矩阵自动确定最优 tile？

方法 Waypoint 是解析分析模型：刻画内存层级交互、指令级并行与多线程等全部架构效应，以估计性能为代理搜索 tile 空间；并用它构建 OPAM CPU GEMM 库自动分解 GEMM。

关键数字 性能匹配 SOTA GEMM 库；在 CPU 上加速 LLM 推理 1.36-1.98x。

为什么值得看 CPU GEMM tile 选择的解析模型，还可帮硬件设计者估计实验性优化的现实性能。

item.title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs).

Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Transporting Quantiles to Codebook: Scalable Vector Quantization without Codebook Collapse
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models.

Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. We evaluated on image tokenization and generation, as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization, demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: TimeWorld: Towards Action-Conditioned Multimodal World Models for Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Time series forecasting supports decision-making in web applications such as online retail and network management, where planned actions can reshape future d...

Time series forecasting supports decision-making in web applications such as online retail and network management, where planned actions can reshape future dynamics. World models provide a natural paradigm for predicting such action-dependent changes beyond extrapolating historical patterns. However, existing time series world models (TSWMs) typically rely on fixed, domain-specific covariate schemas that limit flexible intervention specification, while multimodal forecasters treat text primarily as passive predictive context. To investigate these gaps, we introduce TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for multimodal TSWMs spanning seven real-world datasets, with textual interventions grounded in recorded action--outcome data. Our evaluation reveals that conventional multimodal forecasters underperform history-only time series foundation models (TSFMs) despite dataset-specific training, whereas simple text-prefix adaptations improve forecasting across all evaluated TSFM backbones. These findings suggest that pretrained TSFMs encode implicit world knowledge of temporal dynamics, offering a strong foundation for action-conditioned modeling beyond conventional multimodal fusion. item.title: TUON: A Tensor-Aware Optimizer Utilizing Tensor-SVD and Polarization for Large Language Model Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Large scale language model~(LLM) pretraining is increasingly bottlenecked by optimizer efficiency, driving optimizer design from vector-aware methods such as...

Large scale language model~(LLM) pretraining is increasingly bottlenecked by optimizer efficiency, driving optimizer design from vector-aware methods such as AdamW to matrix-aware methods. Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon exploit matrix structure but treat layers independently, neglecting cross-layer correlations. Tensor-aware optimizers are therefore needed, yet existing ones rely on a matricization-based tensor algebra and remain restricted to shallow stacking and specific modules. In this paper, we propose \textbf{TUON}, a novel optimizer built on a transform-based tensor algebra derived from the Tensor-SVD (T-SVD). Unlike methods that polarize a globally unfolded matrix, TUON mixes layers via a unitary transform $\boldsymbol{Q}$ and then polarizes each transformed slice, and inverts the transform to recover the update. This mix-then-separate strategy captures cross-layer correlations while preserving per-layer diversity, avoiding the structural dimension imbalance and cross-layer misalignment of unfolding. Thus it successfully scales to more layers and diverse modules beyond QKV. Theoretically, we prove that TUON performs steepest descent under a $\boldsymbol{Q}$-transforme…

item.title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental L...

Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental Learning (TSCIL) essential for adapting to new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, preserving diverse and evolving class distributions under strict privacy and memory constraints remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between retaining sufficient historical knowledge for accurate recognition and minimizing the memory required for continual adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a memory-efficient, replay-free framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling rather than sample rehearsal. TRACE employs a compact, frozen temporal-spectral representation and lightweight class-specific autoencoders to capture complex intra-class variations. By independently preserving each class model, TRACE avoids recursive generation and catastrophic forgetting, while enabling direct classification through reconstruction-based scoring without retaining historical samples or large statistical matrices. Extensive experiments across fi…

item.title: Subspace Crystallization in Grokking: Rank Compression Tracks the Phase Transition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Grokking describes understanding something deeply and intuitively.

Grokking describes understanding something deeply and intuitively. In neural networks, it is the phenomenon where a network generalizes long after memorizing its training data. This delay has been linked to a fall in the effective rank of the network's weight matrices, but whether this rank compression drives grokking or follows it is still unresolved. We study a mean-field MLP and a one-layer transformer trained on modular arithmetic and observe that: (i) Compression follows the onset, not memorization. Every transformer memorizes its training data within 250 steps, while the grokking onset (the first step at which test accuracy reaches 95%) varies from 6,500 to 21,000 steps. The steepest fall in effective rank comes about 900 steps after the onset, however late the onset occurs, and networks that memorize without grokking compress far less. (ii) Subspace crystallization. We call the span of the fewest top singular directions of a weight matrix that preserve 99% of test accuracy its sufficient subspace. item.title: Stable Continuous-Time Consistency Distillation: An Empirical Study with a Multistep Extension
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Continuous-time consistency models are an attractive route to few-step generation.

Continuous-time consistency models are an attractive route to few-step generation. They remove the discretization error inherent to the timestep grid that discrete-time consistency models depend on. Until recently, however, training them was unstable. Lu & Song (2025) address this with the TrigFlow formulation and a coordinated set of architectural and training-objective changes. We conduct an independent empirical study of this framework on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64. No open-weight TrigFlow teachers exist at these scales, so we train them from scratch and then verify the consistency distillation (sCD) and consistency training (sCT) behavior of students initialized from these teachers. On CIFAR-10, our students reproduce the reported FID at one and two steps. On ImageNet-64, they fall short, a gap that appears related to our teacher and to architectural choices the paper leaves unspecified. We also report a parameter-count gap of about 5% between the model size stated in the paper and a faithful re-implementation, which we attribute to the scale-and-shift conditioning projections in Adaptive Double Normalization. item.title: Spherical Brownian Diffusion for Language Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Continuous diffusion language models involve two coupled design choices: how to corrupt continuous token representations and how to invert that corruption at...

Continuous diffusion language models involve two coupled design choices: how to corrupt continuous token representations and how to invert that corruption at generation time. Recent work has explored language generation on the unit sphere through geodesic and von Mises--Fisher (vMF) paths, raising the question of which forward process to use on this geometry and how much that choice matters relative to inference. We introduce Spherical Brownian Diffusion, using Brownian motion as the canonical isotropic diffusion on the sphere. Its heat semigroup provides a principled forward process, an additive dimension-free noise clock, and an exact ancestral bridge, while a clean-token posterior learned with cross-entropy supports multiple samplers. To separate corruption from inference, we derive high-dimensional approximation rates between Brownian and moment-matched vMF corruption and use this relationship for controlled substitutions. On Sudoku, Brownian and moment-matched vMF give nearly identical results across four samplers and five budgets under otherwise identical settings. item.title: Sparse Reconstruction by Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation in Function Space
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Understanding physical systems often requires recovering their full spatial state from measurements available only at sparse locations.

Understanding physical systems often requires recovering their full spatial state from measurements available only at sparse locations. This reconstruction becomes challenging when physical boundaries are unknown, high-resolution training fields are unavailable, or important quantities cannot be measured directly. Sparse observations may also be consistent with multiple plausible states, leading to significant reconstruction uncertainty. Here we introduce Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation (\DMF{}), a functional rectified flow framework that learns how sparse measurements drive physical-field generation end to end. Instead of relying on grid-based rasterization or runtime guidance, \DMF{} jointly learns a sensor--global--sensor representation with the generative transport, dynamically fusing local grounding with global context to evaluate physical fields at arbitrary query coordinates. Across benchmarks involving unobserved boundaries, missing high-resolution training fields, and unmeasured physical quantities, \DMF{} outperforms alternative baselines by significantly reducing reconstruction errors and preserving the fidelity of physical properties. item.title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates.

Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility joint success from 49.35% with logs and metadata to 65.58%. A deterministic execution-consistency rule reaches 64.94% with higher benign utility, while full restoration reaches 69.48%. Lifecycle tasks distinguish models with similar runtime scores, an…

item.title: Shared Context, Separate Engines: Streaming Vision--Language Inference on Edge SoCs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘 SoC 集成了 CPU/GPU/NPU 却让 VLM 生成只用一个引擎；流式 VLM 有新帧到达与旧查询未答的并行机会，但引擎间计算/内存差异与争用使单点放置失效。

方法 协调异构加速器并发执行有状态 VLM 推理：把流的版本化上下文与各引擎 KV 状态分离，任何引擎可复用/导入/重建状态继续该流；状态感知调度把请求派给预计最快完成的引擎，答案读取固定已发布版本历史以匹配串行参考。

关键数字 Apple M4 Max、RK3588、QCS6490 上超过最强单引擎基线（含上下文复用）；RK3588 双视频流比最优单引擎+复用高 19.6% 吞吐、比无共享状态并行引擎高 27.2%；跨引擎 KV 导入使首 token 延迟比前缀重算降 4.6x；流式生成吞吐最高 2.48x；状态感知调度使查询完成时间最高降 72.7%。

为什么值得看 边缘 SoC 异构引擎协同跑 VLM 的完整运行时设计，多引擎并行收益实测。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing temporal dependencies across multiple scales while accounting for both shared and variable-specific d...

Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing temporal dependencies across multiple scales while accounting for both shared and variable-specific dynamics. Compact forecasting models have emerged as an attractive alternative to increasingly large architectures, but preserving strong predictive performance within tight computational and memory budgets remains challenging. We propose a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns a shared bank of multi-scale temporal filters of each variable. Lightweight variable-specific scalar weights determine the contribution of each temporal component, enabling the model to capture shared temporal structure while adapting to variable-specific dynamics. The learned weights and filter-output energy further provide a natural signal for structured pruning of convolutional filters, reducing computational complexity with minimal degradation in forecasting performance. We additionally introduce an amplitude-adaptive normalization mechanism that preserves variable-dependent temporal amplitudes. item.title: SPARTA: A Sparse Ternary LLM Accelerator with Adaptive Attention and Unified Datapath for Long-Context Edge Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘 LLM 受内存与带宽限制，1.58-bit 三元权重大幅省存储，但长上下文推理被 KV 流量与 attention 卡住；现有加速器还对三元线性层与 attention 用分离数据通路。

方法 SPARTA 稀疏三元加速器：阶段感知稀疏数据流（prefill 计算密集、decode 内存密集）；统一计算阵列把三元 SpMM/SpMV 与位串行 attention 映射到共享 PE；自适应两阶段 attention（页级 Top-k 减 K-cache 访问 + token 级 Top-p 减 V-cache 流量）。

关键数字 KV 流量较全 attention 减 4.1-4.8x、较 SOTA 稀疏 attention 方案 1.3-1.5x（任务依赖质量损失）；较 Jetson AGX Orin 生成吞吐高 3.9x、端到端能效高 8.3x；较 AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 分别为 5.0x 与 81.7x。

为什么值得看 三元 LLM 边缘加速器完整方案，KV 流量与注意力同时优化的量化收益齐全。

item.title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult an...

Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout…

item.title: Risk-Aware Output Control Should be the Focus of Machine Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Well-documented failure modes of machine learning (ML) systems, including bias, toxicity, hallucination, and leakage of sensitive information, has driven the...

Well-documented failure modes of machine learning (ML) systems, including bias, toxicity, hallucination, and leakage of sensitive information, has driven the rise of machine unlearning (MU). Most existing work, however, targets parameter-space indistinguishability, seeking unlearned models that are as close as possible to models retrained from scratch on retained data. In this paper, we argue that this objective is misaligned with practical and user-relevant concerns: MU should prioritize statistically guaranteed output-space control rather than parameter-space similarity. We contend that output control with statistical guarantees is the operationally meaningful notion of unlearning, as it supports rigorous and robust objectives, scales to modern deployment settings, and enables interpretable guarantees. We substantiate this position with empirical evidence and with recent theoretical results that, although not originally formulated in this framing, are consistent with it.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Relational Composition as Parallel Transport: What Per-Entity Frames Force in Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system.

A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system. Content words have one; a fresh entity does not: rotating its coordinates alone changes nothing. We take this per-entity frame freedom as a symmetry and ask what it forces in attention. For orthogonal transports, invariant scores depend only on norms and the transported inner product $\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$; equivariant messages lie in the span of $x_i$ and $T_{ij}x_j$. Endpoint channel count bounds transport rank, so with one vector per entity relations must be supplied; standard attention is the flat sector of a shared frame. Representation theory attaches an integer to each mechanism; the readout decides which. With orthogonal transitions, a convex-cell readout composes a finite group exactly only at or above its smallest faithful real representation dimension. At this minimum, exactness forces a faithful representation. An even readout can decode a cover at smaller width, and the gap is unbounded. Below its threshold, the part of the group a mechanism cannot see sets an accuracy ceiling computable before training. 17/17 fitting seeds at minimal width passed tests through length 1000, versus 7…

A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system.

A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system. Content words have one; a fresh entity does not: rotating its coordinates alone changes nothing. We take this per-entity frame freedom as a symmetry and ask what it forces in attention. For orthogonal transports, invariant scores depend only on norms and the transported inner product $\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$; equivariant messages lie in the span of $x_i$ and $T_{ij}x_j$. Endpoint channel count bounds transport rank, so with one vector per entity relations must be supplied; standard attention is the flat sector of a shared frame. Representation theory attaches an integer to each mechanism; the readout decides which. With orthogonal transitions, a convex-cell readout composes a finite group exactly only at or above its smallest faithful real representation dimension. At this minimum, exactness forces a faithful representation. An even readout can decode a cover at smaller width, and the gap is unbounded. Below its threshold, the part of the group a mechanism cannot see sets an accuracy ceiling computable before training. 17/17 fitting seeds at minimal width passed tests through length 1000, versus 7…

item.description:

Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training.

Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones. These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. item.title: Quantifying the failure of symmetry learning in linear diffusion models due to initialization and finite-sample effects
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Data distributions often possess one or more symmetries: for example, all orientations of any specific dog are included in the distribution of all possible d...

Data distributions often possess one or more symmetries: for example, all orientations of any specific dog are included in the distribution of all possible dog pictures. Despite the omnipresence of such symmetries, modern generative modeling approaches may fail to incorporate or learn them, which can lead to lower sample efficiency and poorer generalization. To what extent do diffusion models fail to learn data distribution symmetries, and what sources of symmetry breaking are most responsible? Here, we answer this question in the theoretically tractable setting of linear diffusion models. We show that of three potential sources of symmetry breaking---a non-symmetric initial weight matrix, a noisy learning target, and finite-sample noise---target noise produces the most robust symmetry breaking, since it persists even in the sample-rich regime. Using local laws from random matrix theory, we derive formulas for average symmetry error in fairly general cases involving symmetry within a subspace and show that smaller symmetries are harder to learn.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron.

We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron. First we prove a strong form of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture on neurons over finite fields, where the activation function is a certain modification of the discrete logarithm, using the Weil bound on multiplicative character sums over finite fields. Then we show a generalisation of Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons with a weight vector independent of the target function, positively answering another question in the literature. The proof of the latter uses an equidistribution theorem for the dilates of certain maps into tori.

item.title: Priority-Preserving Advantage Aggregation for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency.

LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency. However, the widely used additive reward aggregation in RL can violate these priorities: when primary and auxiliary advantages conflict, a sufficiently large auxiliary signal can overturn the preference induced by the primary objective. We term this problem \emph{advantage priority inversion}. Although reward-level gating can protect priority more directly, it still removes potentially useful auxiliary distinctions among rollout samples that fail the primary condition. To address this trade-off, we propose Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (\textbf{PAPO}), a priority-aware advantage aggregation method that asymmetrically combines a primary and an auxiliary advantage. PAPO retains auxiliary supervision when the objectives agree and smoothly attenuates conflicting auxiliary signals, preserving the primary sign during fusion for \emph{primary-consistent ordering}. This rule applies to sequence-level advantages in GRPO and token-level advantages in actor--critic PPO. Experiments on multiple domains and models show that PAPO consistently achieves the best prim…

item.title: Priority-Aware Scheduler for Serverless Functions Provision and Load Balancing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Serverless computing has emerged as a pivotal cloud deployment paradigm due to its efficient utilization of on-demand resources.

Serverless computing has emerged as a pivotal cloud deployment paradigm due to its efficient utilization of on-demand resources. However, the persistent cold start problem continues to hinder system performance. Current strategies often employ oversimplified preloading/unloading mechanisms that inadequately exploit invocation patterns, failing to optimize the critical trade-off between startup latency and resource efficiency. Furthermore, existing approaches disregard practical constraints of memory-limited multi-worker environments, exacerbating function eviction and load imbalance issues. To address these limitations, we present SPES-Ext, a rule-based priority-aware scheduler designed for memory-constrained distributed worker nodes. Our methodology stems from two key observations: (1) serverless systems exhibit concentrated invocation patterns enabling behavioral predictability, and (2) these patterns permit function categorization for granular instance management. This insight posits that characteristic-driven prioritization enables optimal scheduling rules, leading to our system design, which integrates three coordinated components: predictive function provisioning, eviction op…

Bayesian variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provide principled uncertainty estimation when fine-tuning large foundation models, but require specifying the prior over the low-rank weight updates. We address this hyperparameter selection problem by introducing a closed-form prior-predictive estimator that operates before fine-tuning. We analyze a second-order expansion of the network and quantify how the low-rank prior drives function-space deviations from the pretrained outputs. We also show that these prior-predictive quantities depend on the prior only through the product of the adaptation rank and the fourth power of the prior scale. Because the training targets share a single draw of the latent weight update, we can leverage the covariance between example residuals to derive a moment-matching estimator. Furthermore, our theoretical analysis establishes that the optimal prior precision scales as $r^{-1/2}$ with the rank $r$, allowing a single estimate to generalize across all ranks. item.title: PaFeDSE: Pareto-Feedback-Guided Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration for Efficient Pareto Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors.

Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. While machine-learning-based DSE significantly reduces the cost of exhaustively evaluating large design spaces, existing methods still waste expensive simulations on Pareto-miss candidates that do not improve the Pareto frontier and repeatedly process redundant candidates during iterative exploration. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations. Evaluated on SPEC CPU 2017 workloads, PaFeDSE requires up to 49.0% fewer simulations than the strongest prior baseline to reach target hypervolume levels, while achieving a 7.1x reduction in exploration overhead through adaptive candidate filtering.

item.description:

Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmen...

Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. item.title: One-Shot Federated Model Editing for Device Dynamics at the Edge
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments ...

Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments such as vehicular networks, where devices frequently join and leave. One-shot FL offers a promising alternative by completing training in a single communication round. However, one-shot FL suffers from model solidification and cannot readily adapt to subsequent client dynamics, including new client contributions and the withdrawal of previous contributions. We therefore consider exact model editing, which removes withdrawn contributions through unlearning or incorporates newly contributed ones through incremental learning without retraining from scratch. We identify that efficient editing fundamentally hinges on learning stability. To this end, we propose F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot FL algorithm that enables rapid and exact model editing. F-SOSA leverages sub-sampling of local models with carefully tuned rate for stable aggregation and performs curvature-aware model fusion to preserve utility. We prove that F-SOSA achieves vanishing training error and reasonably small generalization error bounds. Building on this stabilit…

item.description:

研究问题 内核融合应延伸到多远、哪些边界值得保留？单一巨型 megakernel 是否总是最优？

方法 提出不端到端跑任何候选设计的框架：从常规图 profile 与独立 kernel 基准选择 megakernel 区域，模拟各候选 tile/事件图预测首输出时间；并引入四类模型分类（megakernel-stable/receding/advancing/averse）刻画最优组合随批大小的变化。

关键数字 13 个模型-批组合全部选出实测最优设计；NH-TTS/Qwen3-TTS/Llama-1B 上最优组合为 2-4 个 megakernel 到全常规图、无一为单一 megakernel；NH-TTS H100 NVL 批 32 下保留三个专用 megakernel：批 p95 TTFA 低 21.4%、吞吐高 28%；较 TensorRT 常规图引擎级批 TTFA p95 降 4.05x、吞吐升 19.7%。

为什么值得看 回答 megakernel 该不该"一个到底"的实证框架，流式推理内核设计直接参考。

item.title: NOMAD-EEG: Native Omni-Montage Adaptive Diffusion
item.description:

Purpose.

Purpose. Electroencephalography (EEG) montages, channel counts and recording lengths vary widely, but most EEG foundation models are bound to the channel set and input length they were trained on. We aimed to build a generative EEG foundation model independent of the number, identity and order of electrodes and of the input length. Methods. NOMAD-EEG is a 12.0 M-parameter diffusion model that alternates state-space layers along time, without patches, with attention across electrodes identified only by their 3D scalp position. It was pre-trained on 147 h of unlabelled EEG from a single corpus and evaluated with frozen linear probes on ten datasets with 1 to 64 electrodes against seven foundation models run under one protocol, and on two unseen populations. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Exploration in physical control environments requires agents to identify actions whose consequences reveal previously unexplored aspects of the underlying dy...

Exploration in physical control environments requires agents to identify actions whose consequences reveal previously unexplored aspects of the underlying dynamics. However, many intrinsic motivation methods rely on immediate prediction errors, state novelty, or local physical changes, which may overlook informative outcomes that emerge across extended temporal horizons. We investigate whether learning structured representations of reachable futures can provide a more effective basis for exploration. To this end, we introduce Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC$^2$), a framework that combines multi-horizon temporal representation learning with Hamiltonian phase-space structure. A horizon-conditioned contrastive critic learns temporal relationships from future-state pairs sampled within the same episode. The distance between positive-pair representations is then used as an intrinsic reward, encouraging the agent to explore futures that remain insufficiently organized in the learned representation. item.title: Mechanistic Insights into LoRA: Layer Sparsity for Adaptive Fine-Tuning via Path Patching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models.

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA's adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a $3.5\times$ reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adapti…

item.title: Making the Telemetry Pipeline Measurable: An Edge IoT Testbed and Dataset for End-to-End Latency, Provenance, and Energy-Aware Benchmarking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Edge-centric IoT systems are increasingly evaluated through sensor values or platform features, yet the telemetry pipeline itself, the sequence of sensing, s...

Edge-centric IoT systems are increasingly evaluated through sensor values or platform features, yet the telemetry pipeline itself, the sequence of sensing, serialization, message mediation, ingestion, and persistence, is rarely released as a measurable object. This limits reproducible benchmarking of timeliness, provenance, and operational cost, especially in early-stage IoT design where real deployments and high-quality open data are often unavailable. I present a measurement-first edge IoT testbed and dataset that elevate timeliness, provenance, and energy to first-class telemetry dimensions. The testbed operationalizes a role-based event-driven architecture with explicit Source-Broker-Aggregator responsibilities and a schema-governed TelemetryMessage envelope (Avro) that embeds correlation identifiers and a uniform, cross-role vocabulary of stage-level timestamps. To trace mediation effects, I extend an MQTT broker (Eclipse Mosquitto) with a plugin that annotates messages with high-precision ingress/egress timestamps. I release the dataset in a dual representation: (i) replayable raw events as compressed Avro streams and (ii) analysis-ready long-format Parquet tables partitioned…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV 布局转换昂贵、通信随上下文长度增长，如何端到端优化？

方法 MCF 是内存与通信感知框架：MARS 利用早期内存余量选择性复制高复用 KV 块、随 prefill 推进渐进排空冗余副本并收敛为分片 decode-ready 布局；解码采用 query-centric 执行模型（KV 分片驻留、轻量 query 跨 worker 路由）；FPGA compute-NIC 数据通路在网络路径内做元数据驱动 KV 路由与集合操作。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；TTFT、吞吐与可扩展性优于 SOTA 分布式推理系统，上下文与集群规模越大收益越大。

为什么值得看 同时从 KV 布局生命周期与通信形态下手的长上下文分布式推理设计。

item.title: Live Adaptation of Dataflow Stream Processing for Hybrid Edge-Cloud Analytics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Dataflow streaming systems, like Apache Flink and Spark Streaming, are integral to modern business analytics, providing real-time insights across industries.

Dataflow streaming systems, like Apache Flink and Spark Streaming, are integral to modern business analytics, providing real-time insights across industries. However, for emerging hybrid edge-cloud analytics pipelines, neither processing everything in the cloud nor static edge offloading can reliably sustain the target rate under dynamic WAN conditions and limited edge resources. In this paper, we explore how these datacenter-centric platforms can be extended to support such hybrid analytics pipelines. Our goal is to maintain full transparency for user applications, while retaining built-in fault tolerance, out-of-order processing, and existing ecosystem integrations. Achieving this is challenging because existing dataflow engines assume homogeneous resources, rely on static task placement, and do not support adaptation under dynamic network and edge conditions. We introduce Sluice, an adaptive data stream processing system for hybrid clouds, compatible with dataflow streaming engines. Sluice's key contributions are: (i) an automatic query rewriter that decomposes applications into independent, fault-tolerant segments, and (ii) a live routing mechanism that shifts computations betw…

item.title: LEAP: a Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer for time-series anomaly detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Time-series anomaly detection is dominated by reconstruction-based neural detectors, whose objective is structurally flawed.

Time-series anomaly detection is dominated by reconstruction-based neural detectors, whose objective is structurally flawed. Since the target is also the input, an expressive model can learn to reconstruct anomalies too, leaving uninformative residuals. Recent large-scale benchmarks show that, on curated data, elaborate deep detectors rarely beat simple statistical baselines, while current leaders rely on representation learning. We propose LEAP (Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer), which combines masked prediction with latent representation-based anomaly evidence, without relying on reconstruction or attention-based scoring. The model removes patches from a window and predicts them from the remaining temporal and cross-channel context, so prediction errors measure how well learned dynamics explain hidden segments. Deterministic complementary group masking ensures every time step is scored while hidden, with identical visible fractions during training and inference. LEAP adds three label-free evidence sources: latent-embedding novelty calibrated by local density, local temporal contrast, and per-channel novelty pooled over channels selected by six label-free criteria. Under…

item.title: InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 多轮 agent RL 的长闭环 rollout 使生成与 KV 成本成为瓶颈；量化 rollout 省成本，但低精度执行器作为行为策略会与 learner 产生执行失配，且沿状态到达历史累积。

方法 InterQ-RL 在状态到达策略历史上做有界执行前缀修正，按固定位移预算在动作段间分配修正强度，无需额外模型前向。

关键数字 4B-30B 稠密与 MoE 骨干、ALFWorld/WebShop/ScienceWorld 四环境-骨干组合，各量化支共享 W8A8-KV8 rollout；取得最强量化端点结果，匹配 BF16 到 0.7 分以内、两个设置超过 BF16。

为什么值得看 量化 agentic RL 执行失配的后对齐修正，低成本 rollout 与学习质量兼得。

item.title: Intent-Preserving Adversarial User Simulation for Multi-Turn Agent Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance.

Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance. We here introduce StressSim, an intent-preserving adversarial user simulator framework for stress-testing agents with challenging yet valid user interactions. StressSim optimises the simulator's high-level adversarial plan for each task instance. Candidate planner prompts are evolved with a genetic prompt-optimisation loop that uses rollout traces, granular task-completion signals, and validity feedback to favour conversations that reduce task success without changing the user's underlying goal. We evaluate the approach on the MultiWOZ dataset and the retail and airline domains from tau-bench with three target LLM agents, comparing against standard simulators and hand-designed non-collaborative user behaviours. We demonstrate the effectiveness of StressSim in exposing robustness gaps across frontier LLMs, with tau-bench pass^4 scores decreasing by up to 69% on gemini-3.8-flash and 62% on gpt-5.6-sol. StressSim maintains goal preservation performance (which decreases by at most 10%), using an optimisation budget of 20 rollout…

item.title: Inference Latency-Aware Tsetlin Machine Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

The Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning model well suited to low-latency inference on resource-constrained edge devices.

The Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning model well suited to low-latency inference on resource-constrained edge devices. Because each clause is an AND over Boolean literals, both the literals and their associated Tsetlin Automaton (TA) actions can be represented at the bit level, enabling bitwise evaluation and an early exit that is triggered as soon as any included literal evaluates to zero, forcing the clause output to zero. In this work, we study how the two TM training hyperparameters, T and s, govern both classification accuracy and inference latency. Building on the inversely proportional T-s relationship along which accuracy is nearly constant, we find that inference latency is reduced primarily by increasing s; rather than exhaustively searching the (T, s) grid at high training cost, we propose a directed search strategy that treats accuracy as a constraint and advances toward larger s to reduce inference latency within a fixed evaluation budget. Experimental results on the gem5 simulator with an ARM processor show that, for certain datasets, the search is able to increase s while preserving the baseline accuracy, thereby reducing inference latency at neg…

item.title: How Numerical Errors Scale with Hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

In this short technical note, we outline how to bound numerical errors with respect to computational resources.

In this short technical note, we outline how to bound numerical errors with respect to computational resources. We consider algorithms with known complexity estimates that can be executed in parallel and combine these estimates with parallelization laws. We suppose that the proposed approach generalizes beyond the presented examples and argue that it provides a straightforward and fair framework for comparing algorithms, hardware systems, and software implementations. This is achieved by imposing identical resource or energy budgets on each configuration, and comparing the resulting numerical error evaluations.

item.title: HiLO: Towards Product-Level Graceful Degradation with a Quality-Aware, Load-Aware Control Framework
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Graceful degradation is a key mechanism employed by large-scale systems to handle overload conditions.

Graceful degradation is a key mechanism employed by large-scale systems to handle overload conditions. Its importance has grown further as GPU-intensive LLM inference introduces persistent capacity constraints that cannot be addressed through provisioning alone. Common degradation approaches rely on service-level mechanisms such as load shedding and circuit breakers, or on feature-level switches (some manually controlled) to preserve availability and quality. While effective at protecting services, such approaches lead to untestable product states and thereby unpredictable product quality. We present HiLO (High Load Optimizer), an automated product-level degradation system designed to handle graceful degradation at scale. HiLO maps observed load to a product state lattice: a small set of pre-validated product states, partially ordered by degradation severity. Dependencies are resolved at design time enabling deterministic and continuous control without requiring runtime dependency discovery. item.title: Governing Enterprise AI Traffic at Scale: Design and Operation of a Policy-Driven, Multi-Vendor LLM Gateway on Envoy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol an...

Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evaluated by Open Policy Agent and managed through a control plane with role-scoped authoring, approvals, pilots, shadow-mode rollout, usage notifications and versioned policy bundles. For use cases that require it, a data-loss-prevention layer can block, …

Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol an...

Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evaluated by Open Policy Agent and managed through a control plane with role-scoped authoring, approvals, pilots, shadow-mode rollout, usage notifications and versioned policy bundles. For use cases that require it, a data-loss-prevention layer can block, …

item.title: GNN-VIEW: Visual Inspection and Explanation of Graph-based Earth-System Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development.

Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development. Graph-based models, one of the most prominent approaches, allow developers to constrain the learning process before training via graph connectivity. Yet, developing these models remains challenging: the graph is built algorithmically with little intuition about the final result beyond static plotting, which requires extra work and is often not detailed enough. Even after successful training, how the model arrives at forecasts remains obscure. We present GNN-VIEW, an interactive browser-based tool that supports the development of such systems. GNN-VIEW exposes the graph's information pathways, allowing model developers to debug the graph structure before training. After training, GNN-VIEW uses attribution-based explainability to reveal which input features are used by the trained model for a given forecast. This helps developers understand why a model fails. We showcase the usefulness of GNN-VIEW in the construction stage of a graph for an ocean forecasting model, and in explaining poorly predicted precipitation of a trained weather forecasting model during Hurricane Laura.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

The realm of high-performance computing has expanded to include machine learning tasks of many forms. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are becoming increasingly popular, with their applications expanding across diverse domains. As the scale of graph data continues to grow, including larger numbers of nodes, edges, and higher embedding dimensions, standardized libraries such as DGL and PyG have been developed to facilitate GNN computation. item.title: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions.

Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on leg…

item.title: Efficient probabilistic weather forecasting at quarter-degree resolution with two-sided transport attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding.

High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding. Here we present Astra, a 0.25$^\circ$ ensemble model trained on eight H200 GPUs. It combines Kantorovich Attention, a two-sided transport attention in which each region chooses where it reads from and writes to, so every region sends and receives at token resolution, with a self-featurised continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) that also scores forecasts in the model's multiscale features. In WeatherBench 2, Astra matches GenCast's CRPS averaged over five upper-air targets and days 1-10 with 9.8% of its hardware-normalised training compute. Verified against ERA5, its CRPS and ensemble-mean root-mean-square error are lower than the ECMWF ensemble's on all 600 variable, level and lead-time combinations, and its CRPS is lower than GenCast's on 73.5% of them. A 15-day member needs 39 times fewer floating-point operations than GenCast's GPU implementation, and 50 members take under 40 min on one consumer GPU, within 21 GB.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropa...

Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropagation while communicating only random seeds and scalar coefficients. However, existing methods lack efficient mechanisms for exact unlearning to fully remove the influence of training data when users request deletion. A key insight is that total variation stability of the learning algorithm creates overlap between model distributions before and after data deletion, allowing exact unlearning to reuse computation through coupling. item.title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years.

The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years. Recent machine learning advances achieve high predictive performance of instability dynamics, but as black-box systems cannot be interpreted to connect to existing scientific understanding. Here we show analytic equations that predict when a multi-planet system will undergo instability. We discover these equations by first training a neural network on a dataset of N-body simulations, and then distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions. Our two-stage pipeline first learns an interpretable variable basis, then searches for equations using symbolic regression. The resulting equations outperform existing analytic estimates of instability and apply across wide ranges of mass ratios, spacing, and orbital eccentricities. They capture structure in the prediction landscape with a small number of variables amenable to dynamical interpretation. These results demonstrate how symbolic learning can be combined with neural networks to extract scientific insight from complex dynamical systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Detection of Single Stuck-at and Bridging Faults in Cluster-based FPGA Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors gen...

This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors generated by a test pattern generator circuitry. This technique is based on configuration of logic elements using test logic structure and the outputs of two separated logic elements are compared to detect a fault. To do this, block under test, TPG and output response analysis circuitry are generated in FPGAs. The configurations of test pattern generation, block under test and output response analysis are also discussed in this paper. The novelty lies in the fact that the same set of test vectors can detect all the stuck-at as well as bridging faults if the test vectors are applied in a particular sequence and analyzing the output results. We presented a detail analysis of results to detect faults as well.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 遥感场景分类大模型边缘部署难（算力/内存/能耗受限），知识蒸馏学生模型能压缩到什么程度仍保持精度？

方法 提出蒸馏感知压缩循环（DAC-Loop）：结构化通道剪枝前后均做知识蒸馏，迭代压缩调度在结构化剪枝与非结构化稀疏化之间交替。

关键数字 EuroSAT 与 NWPU-RESISC45 上相对一次性剪枝与单阶段 KD 恢复一致改善精度-压缩权衡，参数减少超 90% 仍保持强精度。

为什么值得看 蒸馏与剪枝统一进迭代循环的遥感边缘模型压缩路线。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal tha...

Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. Diversity is therefore carried across whole reasoning traces rather than by per-token randomness, and explor…

item.title: Context Is Not Free: Carbon-Aware LLM Routing for Multi-Turn LLM Web Services across Geo-Distributed Data Centers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint.

The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint. These services typically run in geo-distributed data centers whose grid carbon intensity varies across regions and over time, so routing each query to a cleaner region or a smaller model can reduce emissions. A conversation, however, is a stateful web session: each turn reuses the key--value (KV) cache of its history, which resides only where earlier turns were served. Serving a turn on another deployment requires recomputing this history, whose carbon cost grows with the conversation and can outweigh the saving of the move. Existing carbon-aware LLM routers treat a conversation's queries as independent and ignore this cost. We present CarbonRouter, an online framework that jointly selects the model, GPU type, and region for each query to minimize carbon emissions. CarbonRouter introduces a cache-aware carbon cost model, which charges history recomputation to every candidate deployment using cached-token counts from the serving backends, and uses a lightweight gate that keeps a session on its cached deployment when it would likely move ba…

item.description:

Redundant context affects attention through two distinct mechanisms: repeated items add normalization mass, while score variation within correlated groups can produce extreme individual scores. We separate these effects in a planted retrieval model with exponentially many Gaussian distractors arranged in known, exponentially large clusters. The model is a two-level generalized random energy model, whose classical free energy yields exact retrieval thresholds. Gaussian interpolation further shows that increasing positive correlation at fixed token count lowers the distractor free energy, unlike adding duplicates. Our main result identifies a sharp limitation of subtracting log cluster size from pre-softmax scores: this correction removes multiplicity but retains within-cluster extremes. Even a temperature chosen after observing all scores cannot lower the required signal below $\sqrt{2α_1}$, where $α_1$ is the exponential rate of the number of clusters. Averaging scores before exponentiation instead suppresses these fluctuations and achieves $\sqrt{2ρα_1}$, where $ρ$ is the within-cluster correlation. item.title: Benchmarking uncertainty quantification for engineering regression under graded distribution shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most.

Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most. Existing comparisons of regression UQ methods rely on random splits, which assess calibration only in distribution. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. All tuning uses source data only. In distribution, conformal methods cover at least 0.946 of test points on every dataset. Under hard shift, mean coverage falls to 0.40-0.75 across the 11 methods that always return an interval, and no systematic difference in method ranks is detected (Friedman p = 0.63). Weighted conformalised quantile regression stays near nominal on the points it answers, but abstains on 85\% of hard-shift points on average and covers only 0.67 of the few Concrete points it answers. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress.

As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. item.title: Attention under Bounded Key-Query Similarity: Space Complexity and Transformer Anisotropy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation.

A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation. These methods compress the stored context while approximately preserving attention computation, enabling generation with reduced memory consumption. Almost tight theoretical results on the worst case space complexity of attention have recently been obtained, but they are achieved by instances where queries can be perfectly aligned with keys. This directly contradicts the observed anisotropy of the key/query geometry in real transformers. In particular, it has been shown empirically that key/query cosine similarities are small even for most correlated pairs, i.e., near-perfect alignment of queries with keys does not happen in practice. In this paper, we study the space complexity of attention approximation under the assumption that key/query cosine similarities belong to a small interval around zero, i.e., a query cannot align too much with any key. We give a nearly space optimal algorithm and a corresponding space lower bound. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive.

Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive. We introduce Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE), a method for estimating such rare failure probabilities efficiently. ALE uses the change in token log-probabilities induced by the safety fine-tuning to define an amplification direction, along which we increase the failure rate for cheap measurement. We develop a score-function estimator that uses the selected amplified batch to recover the local slope of the log failure rate from the token probabilities of the sampled failures, enabling extrapolation back to rare target rates. We also use the amplified batch to obtain an importance-sampling estimate. item.title: AgriDefend: A $205 Offline Edge Device that Detects Crop Stress Before Visible Symptoms via Multimodal AI Fusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 田间作物监测设备多为单一模态（冠层相机或土壤探针），无法在症状可见前发现地下起始的胁迫。

方法 AgriDefend 融合两模态：MobileNetV2 CNN 分析冠层图像，Random Forest 整合单土壤探针趋势特征（湿度、pH 变化率、N/P/K、地下 CO2 相对环境），logistic 回归元学习器融合为五类作物健康预测；在 Raspberry Pi 5 上离线运行，无云无蜂窝链路。

关键数字 温室干旱试验（野生萝卜）融合模型 87% 准确率（R²=0.88、MAE=0.05），1.4s INT8 TensorFlow Lite 推理；土壤信号比可见萎蔫早约 4 天；物料清单 205 美元，约为商用同类节点 1/5。

为什么值得看 205 美元离线多模态边缘设备实证，无连接场景可持续作物监测的消费电子级方案。

item.title: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict out...

Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. It admits a closed-form expression for affine Gaussian transport and tractable Monte Carlo estimators otherwise. Treating the tNTK as the covariance function of a Gaussian proce…
