item.title: H-GLow: Accelerating Graph Generation via Hazard-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due ...

Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due to the strong dependencies between nodes and edges. Although DFM decouples training from sampling, enabling flexible sampling strategies without retraining, existing graph DFM samplers often rely on task-specific heuristics, substantially expanding the hyperparameter space. Moreover, graph DFM models still require sampling budgets comparable to those of diffusion-based approaches, leaving their potential for accelerating graph generation only partially realized. In this work, we introduce H-Glow, a hazard-guided framework for accelerating graph generation built on the decomposition of Continuous-Time Markov chain (CTMC) generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions. H-Glow leverages these quantities to plan graph edits and dynamically adjust the sampling time to graph activity. H-Glow can be adapted to pretrained graph DFM models, substantially improving the generation quality with fewer steps. Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federat...

Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federated healthcare diagnostics. While Gradient Boosted Decision Trees are widely used in centralized settings due to their efficiency, they are incompatible with standard gradient-based federated learning protocols because of their non-differentiability. Conversely, standard deep classifiers that are amenable to federated optimization often suffer from catastrophic forgetting under label distribution skew. In this work, to address these gaps we propose Geodesic-SVDD, a framework for Distributed Spherical Prototype Learning that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere, so that local models can be aggregated as probabilistic manifolds in a single round. item.title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks.

Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. item.title: FastSAR: High-Throughput, High-Fidelity Open-Source SAR Image Formation on CPUs, GPUs and TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Exact backprojection of a spaceborne SAR collection needs one interpolated read per pixel for every pulse; for the 12,207 by 8,808 pixel Umbra image of the P...

Exact backprojection of a spaceborne SAR collection needs one interpolated read per pixel for every pulse; for the 12,207 by 8,808 pixel Umbra image of the Panama Canal this balloons to 1.6 trillion reads. FastSAR is an open-source library for SAR image formation on CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs, with factorized backprojection, exact backprojection and polar format behind one Python interface and readers for the vendors' phase-history files. Its factorized kernels form the Panama image in 11.2 s on a 16-vCPU instance, 3.0 s on an NVIDIA L4, 0.6 s on an H100 and 2.9 s on a TPU v6e, with errors of -56 to -63 dB relative to a float64 exact backprojection in three regions over six cloud devices; the L4, a modest GPU, gives the lowest cost of the six at 0.59 US dollars per thousand images. At exact backprojection FastSAR is as fast as the MatX backprojection example, by far the fastest open-source implementation found (10.9 against 11.6 s at the same accuracy, with MatX's pixel coordinates in float64); its factorized algorithm is 3.8 times faster than MatX, and its polar format forms the image in 1.4 s on the L4 at -32 dB. item.title: Faithful Federated Tabular Data Synthesis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era.

Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era. This paper studies the generation of mixed-type tabular synthetic data in federated settings, where two key challenges arise: ensuring distributional fidelity and effectively handling mixed-type data. We propose Federated Integrative Two-Step Synthesis (FITS), a framework for mixed-type tabular data synthesis. At its core is a two-step federated algorithm for estimating conditional cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) using local linear regression. Building on this algorithm, we develop a federated synthesis procedure based on the probability chain rule to ensure distributional fidelity. To handle mixed-type data, FITS introduces a continualization method that lifts discrete variables into a continuous space and recovers their discrete distributions without loss at both the density-function and CDF levels. This transformation provides a unified continuous representation of mixed-type variables, facilitating the application of local linear regression and synthetic data generation. Our theoretical analysis characterizes the conditional density and cumulative distribution functions of the continualized mixed-type variables …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels.

We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels. We adapt a ReLU extraction implementation to Leaky ReLU, compare sign-search methods, and estimate biases and output layers. We prove conditional bounds for direction recovery with approximate prefixes, preservation of local distance votes, prediction changes from aligned parameter errors, and sign selection with independent scoring data. We also specify exact row restoration and distinguish its guarantee from that of gradient masking. The experiments evaluate assisted extraction, with privileged access to gradients, hidden activations, and victim parameters, followed by label-based reconstruction. Across eight search seeds on the largest synthetic architecture, Leaky ReLU recovers 51--57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer, while ReLU recovers none. This advantage does not hold uniformly across architectures and layers. Removing victim-weight access from the sign walk gives less accurate signs, despite high final prediction agreement. item.title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based...

Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence.

Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. item.title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM serving 中 KV 缓存随序列增长限制 GPU 并发，CPU 卸载可扩展容量但现有系统仍 GPU-gated，主机内存与 CPU 算力无法作为独立服务资源。

方法 DualPace 把主机变成独立调度的解码引擎：GPU 引擎执行 prefill 与 GPU 驻留解码，AMX 使能的 CPU 引擎独立批处理并推进 CPU 驻留解码；调度解耦、执行协作，CPU 可本地完成整轮解码迭代或选择性调用 GPU Dense Assist，离线 profile 指导硬件特定批处理与路由。

关键数字 解码场景吞吐较 NEO 提升 6.9-43.2%、较 vLLM 提升 11.5-90.6%，延迟同水平；保留 NEO 的 P99 TTFT 优势，同 P99 ITL 下请求率比 NEO 高 7.3-50.5%。

为什么值得看 把 CPU 侧变成真正独立解码资源的 serving 运行时，KV 卸载路线的重要升级。

item.title: DiffRouter: A Differentiable Routing Framework for UltraScale FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute...

Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute heuristics. This inherent sequentialism limits parallelism, leads to suboptimal utilization of routing resources, and significantly increases runtime on modern FPGAs. This paper introduces DiffRouter, the first differentiable, gradient-based FPGA routing framework with GPU acceleration. By lifting routing into a continuous optimization space, DiffRouter enables highly concurrent routing and improved global optimality before projecting solutions back onto the discrete fabric. The framework consists of three key stages: (1) Resource-pruned preprocessing, which extracts compact routing variables per net to reduce memory footprint and problem complexity; (2) Differentiable global routing via gradient descent, which formulates routing as a Lagrangian-relaxed optimization that minimizes wirelength while iteratively enforcing connectivity and congestion constraints as relaxed terms; and (3) Postprocessing, which maps the continuous wire distributions to a valid UltraScale routing solution and completes solutions by detailed routing. …

item.description:

Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions.

Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. item.title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time.

Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate…

We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate…

Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. item.title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when ana...

The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 稀疏激活使专家权重可驻留 CPU 内存按需传输，但模型稀疏度、CPU/GPU 吞吐、VRAM 与带宽差异会改变卸载策略排序；逐策略实现评估成本过高，如何低成本选优？

方法 COPE 在运行时集成前选出目标配置的最优卸载策略：Policy Matrix 把设计空间分解为专家驻留与 MoE 执行策略两个独立轴并暴露 4 个新候选；Virtual Heterogeneous Machine 刻画目标平台组合算子调度并结合离线路由迹估计性能。

关键数字 最优策略选择准确率提升 24%-100%，性能预测误差降 1.7x-6.8x；集成前定策使策略实现工作量最多降 74%。

为什么值得看 MoE 卸载策略的系统化选择框架，省掉逐策略工程实现成本。

item.title: CFL-aware edge design for graph neural solvers of hyperbolic transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that...

Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that are challenging to capture numerically. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer learned update rules, but neighbor aggregation alone does not tell a GNN how far information must travel and along which edge. As a result, when a GNN model takes a time step larger than what was used in training, shock fronts smear and oscillations grow. In this work, we ask whether making the scale of transport explicit as an edge-local Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) signal can enhance GNNs' ability to model hyperbolic PDEs. Holding the architecture fixed, we vary only the information given to each edge, from a raw edge form to forms that progressively expose the edge-local transport interaction through direction, length, and wave speed. Because all of these are computed from the same ingredients, what changes is not the amount of information but its form. The results show a consistent pattern, in which feature count is not the limiting factor, and appending CFL directly to a raw edge form produces almost no benefit. The CFL conditioning proves most ef…

item.title: Beyond Affine Reconstruction: Multi-Resolution Transformer DeepONets for the Radiative Transfer Equation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck.

Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck. Neural operators can accelerate these computations by learning solution operators from offline simulation data. However, conventional DeepONet surrogates rely on fixed-grid inputs and affine reconstruction, limiting their flexibility across resolutions and their approximation accuracy at a fixed latent dimension. In this paper, we develop a transformer-based DeepONet for multi-resolution RTE surrogate modelling. The proposed approach combines a Perceiver encoder, which maps temperature and absorption coefficient fields at different spatial resolutions into a fixed-size latent representation, with a cross-attention decoder that enables non-affine reconstruction of the radiative intensity. This architecture allows a single model to process inputs at varying resolutions without resampling them onto a common grid. We formulate a computable empirical version of a previously derived theoretical lower bound for affine reconstruction, enabling direct comparison with model errors on the same dataset. item.title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning Scaling Laws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a...

The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a large-scale training job based on inexpensive experiments at smaller scales. Guided by these empirical scaling laws, the deep learning community has achieved great success in training large (self-)supervised models on Internet-scale datasets. In contrast, despite its potential and wide application, reinforcement learning (RL) has yet to find a guiding principle for predictable scaling. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of RL scaling laws of an actor-critic algorithm in two procedurally generated environments, Starpilot and Craftax. We discover empirical scaling laws with strong predictive performance in both environments. The discovered scaling laws accurately predict the aforementioned three quantities for larger-scale training jobs up to two orders of magnitude in total training compute. In particular, we employ a variant of Elo scores for the single-agent RL paradigm as an alternative performance metric than the commonly used mean episode return. Our results show that the Elo score is a much more predictable metri…

item.title: Adapting DNNs to Embrace Voltage Scaling Induced Errors via Accumulation-Aware Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 电压缩放是强力的降功耗手段，但新一代工艺节点上吞吐退化严重且易受工艺变化影响，DNN 的能效-可靠性如何兼得？

方法 软硬件协同：累积感知训练把累加器时序鲁棒位区间作为一阶优化约束，混合精度量化+非结构化剪枝约束权重分布避开硬件敏感的高秩进位链；架构侧做选择性 MSB 掩蔽与细粒度门控时钟，并逐层动态频率缩放适配累加器动态范围。

关键数字 深度缩放的 2nm 节点低电压前沿下，协同优化 post-layout 架构较标称电压实现能耗降 39%、能量延迟积降 23%，精度退化在 1% 以内。

为什么值得看 面向电压缩放容错的完整软硬件协同方案，低功耗 DNN 能效收益量化清晰。

item.title: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspec...

In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. Furthermore, when the target distribution itself depends on the model being optimized, we show that the accumulation of estimation variance can induce a deterministic degradation of the target distribution. These results provide a theoretical explanation, at least in part, for the long-term behavior of existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. With this intuitio…

item.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 强化学习常用独立推理与训练系统，即便权重与 BF16 张量一致，实现差异也会使本应在策略的更新偏离策略、训练不稳定——能否只对齐部分执行栈就稳定 BF16 RL？

方法 把训练侧舍入位置与推理对齐三个区域：RoPE、SwiGLU 与残差 RMSNorm，方法是在其 BF16 输出前将选定中间量保留为 FP32；推理引擎、矩阵乘/注意力 kernel 与学习目标均保持不变。

关键数字 在四个 Qwen 系列模型上，对齐全部三个区域防止了默认 BF16 基线下的训练崩溃；单对齐 RoPE 路径在实验中也已足够，尽管仍有数值差异残留。

为什么值得看 "舍入位置对齐"而非全局精度升级来稳定 BF16 RL，代价极小，RL 训练工程可直接采用。

item.title: When Does Dynamics Randomization Test Context Inference?
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information fo...

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information for a context encoder to add, because distinct latent parameters may produce similar transitions at visited states, or those states may already reveal the active context. We formalize the remaining one-step information as predictive headroom and compare kernels under fixed and visited state--action distributions to distinguish changes in query coverage from changes in context weights. We analyze discrete and continuous environments and find low headroom both when kernels differ little and when visitation reduces an otherwise large discrepancy. At the same time, resetting state components increases headroom, showing that context evidence accumulates in state. We propose reporting this headroom alongside the randomized parameters, so that gains from explicit context inference can be interpreted relative to the information missing from the current state and action.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

研究问题 VLM 视觉 token 数量大导致推理成本高，现有基于 query 的剪枝多用注意力/动态启发式，未显式利用 query-vision 交互的底层结构。

方法 观察到 transformer attention 中 query/key 投影自然诱导的交互矩阵近似低秩、少数主导潜在模式承载 query 相关语义；据此提出 QViD，免训练的 query 感知视觉 token 剪枝方法。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；图像与视频理解基准上、匹配 token 预算下持续提升性能，且在激进压缩区间增益最大。

为什么值得看 把低秩结构洞察直接变成免训练剪枝，VLM 推理成本优化的即插即用思路。

方法 观察到 transformer attention 中 query/key 投影自然诱导的交互矩阵近似低秩、少数主导潜在模式承载 query 相关语义；据此提出 QViD，免训练的 query 感知视觉 token 剪枝方法。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；图像与视频理解基准上、匹配 token 预算下持续提升性能，且在激进压缩区间增益最大。

为什么值得看 把低秩结构洞察直接变成免训练剪枝，VLM 推理成本优化的即插即用思路。

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 大规模 Transformer 推理的计算与内存需求高，空间加速器在片上带宽与能效上有优势，但为大型模型设计加速器昂贵耗时；现有生成器通常只支持单算子，忽略多算子流水线收益。

方法 提出 TranSAGE，基于编译器的框架：在多算子流水线调度下联合优化大型 Transformer，并自动生成加速器实现；集成设计空间探索引擎、多算子数据流优化与基于动态规划的图划分算法，找出适合流水线的算子簇与最优数据流参数；提供空间架构原语与 lowering pass 自动生成 RTL 实现。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；核心贡献是多算子流水线联合优化的自动加速器生成。

item.title: Toward Open ISA Supercomputing: A Comparative Study of RISC-V, Arm, and x86 Architectures on HPC Workloads
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RISC-V 能否挑战 HPC 领域成熟的 x86 与 Arm？现有研究平台、负载与方法各异、罕有考虑能效，难以公平对比。

方法 用统一软件栈与方法论对比当代 HPC RISC-V、Arm 与 x86 处理器：刻画 Sophgo SG2044，与 NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip、Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ 在四个 HPC 基准（STREAM、HPL、HPL-MxP、HPCG）与四个代表应用（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenFOAM、llama.cpp）上对比；所用 OpenBLAS 版 HPL-MxP 以开源形式发布。

关键数字 SG2044 单核 FP64 8.02 GFLOP/s、内存带宽 7.8 GB/s，64 核时升至 294 GFLOP/s 与 107 GB/s；L2 缓存感知的进程放置使扩展到 16 核近线性，其后受内存带宽饱和限制。

为什么值得看 统一方法下的 RISC-V/Arm/x86 HPC 能效横评，开放指令集超算路线的重要数据点。

item.title: The Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) Method for Time Series Arising from Dynamical Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems.

We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems. CLOCK embeds observed sequences into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via a time-averaged occupation kernel, enabling trajectory comparison through their RKHS norm. For systems governed by differential equations, this formulation rigorously approximates the kernel mean embedding of the invariant Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) measure, meaning our dissimilarity metric approximates the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between attractors. To accommodate general time series, we introduce time lags via Takens' Embedding Theorem to reconstruct the phase space. Crucially, CLOCK natively handles trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations. We validate the proposed metric using spectral clustering, demonstrating superior performance against benchmark methods on both synthetic datasets and a real-world intracranial large-scale electroencephalogram (EEG) dataset. Finally, ablation studies on the Lorenz-96 system are consistent with the theoretical convergence rates of the occupation kernels and highlight the me…

item.title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时序基础模型（TSFM）零样本预测强但预训练成本高——相比需周期性重训的监督单模型，前置投入在全生命周期内是否划算？

方法 建模不同方案在现实工业场景中的累计碳排放：对比 Chronos-2 与经典监督模型的部署生命周期碳成本；针对需要降低 TSFM 自身成本的情形，用无梯度剪枝准则移除单个编码器块，评估其对 FLOPs、CO2、延迟与零样本性能的影响。

关键数字 移除单编码器块（7.9% 参数）带来一致的 6–9% FLOPs/CO2/延迟下降，25 任务基准上零样本预测性能基本无损；大型或高频查询部署中 Chronos-2 数月内摊薄预训练成本，小型或低频场景经典模型长期更便宜。

为什么值得看 从全生命周期碳成本看 TSFM 值不值得用，可持续 AI 的成本核算样例。

item.title: Sparsity-driven emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show th...

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show that sparsity inducing regularization promotes functional modularity in multitask networks without predefined module boundaries. Using functional profiling in multilayer perceptrons and a lightweight transformer, we identified compact, task-selective subnetworks, termed functional tokens. Across rule-based task families, selectively retaining these tokens preserves their associated functions while reducing performance on other tasks. Such specialization develops preferentially in deeper layers during training, while earlier layers retain shared computation. Regularization strength and form shape module compactness and specialization, while task weighting alters functional allocation. Moreover, extracted functional tokens can be recombined through alternative pathways to reconstruct a learned composite computation without retraining, preserving their connectivity and learned weights. Our results suggest that sparsity-constrained optimization shapes not only parameter use but also the organization and reuse o…

item.title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse sea...

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer...

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rethinking LoRA Initialization for Robust Asymmetric Learning Rates
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain com...

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $η_B / η_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. Under standard \initA, the update contains an initialization-induced noise term whose magnitude can be affected by the LR for $B$, $η_B$, the initialization scale $β$, and the adapter rank $r$. In practical LLM fine-tuning, this non-vanishing noise can limit the performance gains expected from LoRA+ style asymmetric LRs. To suppress this effect, we propose \initAA, a s…

item.title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in ...

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to log…

item.title: ReMedI: Inference-Time Refinement and Self-Distillation for Controllable Molecular Optimization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromi...

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromise the lead's potency. RL-based post-training, such as C-MORAL, addresses this problem by fine-tuning molecular language models to directly optimize molecular leads for objectives of interest, which relies on expensive task-specific datasets and faces challenges in achieving multi-objective optimization (MOO). We argue a pre-trained model may already contain useful molecular edits that zero-shot generation cannot efficiently reach. Motivated by the limited search capabilities of zero-shot generation, we develop an efficient Metropolis-Hastings search strategy to better explore the proposal distribution. We propose ReMedI, which uses the molecular language model as a base proposer for inference-time alignment. Given a lead and a set of multi-objective tasks, the model proposes edits conditioned on the current molecule, while Metropolis--Hastings refinement guides sequential edits under an objective for property improvement, preservation, and lead similarity. item.title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to...

Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. item.title: Quantum Cadence: Post-Quantum Consensus with Multiple Concurrent Proposers
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggre...

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggregate the signatures of a whole quorum into a single short signature, which keeps these certificates small. A large-scale quantum computer would break these schemes, and no post-quantum scheme with comparable aggregate size and aggregation time is known. Without aggregation, a certificate holds one large post-quantum signature per member of the quorum, so it becomes infeasible for each validator to broadcast certificates, as modern consensus protocols often require. We present Quantum Cadence, a post-quantum consensus protocol with multiple concurrent proposers that avoids certificates altogether: every validator counts quorums among the messages it has received itself. Its safety and liveness do not even depend on signatures, although we add signatures to obtain accountability. Quantum Cadence builds on Cadence and replaces its slot consensus, Chorus, with Quantum Chorus, which keeps the optimal fast-path latency of Chorus: dissemination followed by two rounds of votes. item.title: Putting Transformer Theories to the Test
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture dif...

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. item.title: PlayerEmbed: Learning Behavioral Fingerprint Representations from Raw Input Sequences
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we intr...

Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we introduce PlayerEmbed, a framework that learns compact and discriminative player embeddings using deep metric learning. Our approach uses a hybrid CNN-LSTM encoder trained on raw input sequences from 1,000 players. We evaluate the model on held-out sequences from these players and on sequences from 1,000 players entirely unseen during training to assess generalization to unseen identities. For player identification, a nearest-centroid classifier built from reference embeddings achieves strong performance, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.950 for players seen during training and 0.879 for players unseen during training. Systematically increasing the number of training players substantially improves generalization to unseen players, indicating a transition from simple fingerprinting to learning transferable behavioral patterns.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices.

The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices. Solutions of the drift-diffusion equations rarely give way to analytical forms, and exhibit strong nonlinearity, with the solutions ranging over several orders of magnitude. These attributes have led to research into numerical solvers, and while many commercial Technology Computer Aided Design (TCAD) packages now exist, they may require long simulation times, exhibit sensitivity to initial guesses, and rely on mesh generation. Further, these solvers are not well suited for inverse problems where the design parameters of a device are retrieved from its desired functional characteristics. To address all these challenges, this work demonstrates the usage of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for the solution of the drift-diffusion equations with errors comparable to traditional simulation software using advanced training techniques to solve problems beyond the well-behaved equilibrium regime. For this study, we specifically choose an abrupt PN-junction in both one and two dimensions that features extreme gradients of the carrier concentrati…

item.title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes se...

Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achieving the best generation quality in all model-benchmark settings while maintaining the strongest or near-strongest semantic diversity across two open-weight model families. It also improves sampling efficiency on math and code benchmarks. Beyond in…

item.title: PARIS: Parallel Arithmetic Reduction and Integrated Selection for MSDF Inner Products
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Existing most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) accelerators serialize input-term processing, causing inner-product latency to increase with fan-in. This paper presents PARIS, an MSDF...

Existing most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) accelerators serialize input-term processing, causing inner-product latency to increase with fan-in. This paper presents PARIS, an MSDF architecture that eliminates input-term serialization through parallel bit-plane reduction and shared carry-save residual selection. For $B$-bit operands, PARIS processes $B^2$ bit-position pairs, independent of fan-in within the supported tile, while generating exact MSDF outputs. Synthesized in 45\,nm at 100\,MHz, the 784-lane INT8 core occupies 0.008701\,mm$^2$ and completes an inner product in 88 cycles. Evaluation on two MNIST multilayer perceptrons demonstrates arithmetic-workload speedups of 240.44$\times$ and 180.47$\times$ over a matched reused-MSDF implementation, reducing arithmetic energy by 98.89\% and 98.58\%, respectively. A synthesized 16-engine accelerator occupies 0.90273\,mm$^2$ and meets the 100\,MHz timing constraint. Assuming immediate weight availability, it delivers a projected throughput of 24.33\,GOPS and an estimated energy efficiency of 1,581.14\,GOPS/W at unchanged mapped power. Bias-aware ReLU detection further reduces modeled arithmetic cycles by 5.52\% and 4.86\%. A separa…

item.title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 部署在 IoT/边缘-云系统中的机器学习模型面对非平稳数据流需要在线自适应，且无法访问完整原始训练集——OOD 输入与灾难性遗忘会严重损害性能。

方法 提出面向 IoT 应用的边缘-云方法论，将持续学习（CL）与 OOD 检测、概念漂移检测整合：用 ODIN 与 ECDD 作为识别可标注信息样本、触发基于回放的模型更新的替代机制；在汽车、医疗与农业数据集上验证。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；结论是该方法论支持模型自适应并缓解灾难性遗忘。

为什么值得看 持续学习×OOD/漂移检测的端到端边缘云方法论，IoT 模型运维可参考。

item.title: On the Limits of Sparse Linear Model with Shuffled Differential Privacy
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differen...

Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differential privacy. Shuffled differential privacy (SDP) sits between the two, offering accuracy closer to the central model without the trust requirement of a central curator. This paper studies sparse linear regression under both non-interactive and interactive SDP protocols. In the non-interactive setting, any non-interactive $(ε,δ)$-SDP protocol is shown to incur an $\ell_2$-norm estimation error of $Ω( \frac{\sqrt{dk}}{nε} )$ with dimension $d$, sparsity $k$, and $n$ users, revealing an inherent dimensionality barrier. In addition, a non-interactive algorithm is proposed that achieves an $\ell_2$-norm upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( \sqrt{\frac{k}{n}} + \frac{d\sqrt{k}}{nε})$. To overcome this barrier, we turn to the interactive user-level setting, where each user holds $m$ samples. item.title: On the Expressive Power of Hook-Indexed State Comprehending State in the React UI Library
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

React is currently the most popular JavaScript library for front-end web development. It endows UI components with state via the useState construct, through a mechanism that we nam...

React is currently the most popular JavaScript library for front-end web development. It endows UI components with state via the useState construct, through a mechanism that we name hook-indexed state. However, React's implementation of hook-indexed state is both fragile and poorly understood. Programmers frequently experience unexpected behavior, and the benefits of programming in this paradigm are wholly unclear. We define Lambda-React-Hook, a core calculus that captures the essence of hook-indexed state, and give it a type system to statically rule out unexpected behavior. We then translate Lambda-React-Hook into a calculus Lambda-React-Ref based on ML-style references, and prove that this translation preserves typability and semantics, thus showing that hook-indexed state is expressible in terms of standard references. The translation is local and admits a compositional definition, but involves significant code duplication. As well as illuminating the essence of state in React, our observations can inform the design of future reactive programming systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: On Latency-Optimal Implementations of the Timestamp Object
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Timestamps are widely used in distributed algorithms to order operations. In this paper, we study the timestamp object (TS), which provides a single operation that returns strictly...

Timestamps are widely used in distributed algorithms to order operations. In this paper, we study the timestamp object (TS), which provides a single operation that returns strictly increasing integers. We ask two questions: What is the maximum resilience and the minimum latency of TS implementations in asynchronous message-passing systems, where latency is measured by worst-case message delay? We answer these questions under various types of failure: crash failures, and Byzantine failures with and without digital signatures. To do so, we give lower bounds and algorithms that determine (1) the optimal resilience of TS implementations under each type of failure, and (2) the optimal latency in all cases but one. Along the way, we introduce a new lower-bound proof technique called a cyclic chain argument, which constructs a cycle of indistinguishable schedules along which the returned timestamps must strictly increase, yielding a contradiction.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Multiple Importance Sampling for Guided Speculative Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

We study an extension of the Guided Speculative Inference (GSI) algorithm for test-time-scaling of large language models (LLMs) to a novel setting where an e...

We study an extension of the Guided Speculative Inference (GSI) algorithm for test-time-scaling of large language models (LLMs) to a novel setting where an ensemble of smaller LLMs proposes draft reasoning steps which are later verified by a larger base model and a process reward model. Using the established framework of multiple importance sampling (MIS), we introduce weighting schemes to aggregate samples from a diverse collection of proposal distributions. We provide new bounds on the KL divergence from the optimal reward-tilted target distribution and the expected reward degradation, then demonstrate that the well-known balance heuristic is optimal. Compared to GSI with a single well-tuned drafter, combining several diverse LLMs while retaining the same total number of samples maintains competitive pass-at-$N$ downstream performance while being mathematically robust to situations where the support of a single draft model does not cover that of the target, where GSI may fail.

Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations enable orbital edge computing for latency-critical geocentric applications, but satellite motion compresses line-of-sight commun...

Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations enable orbital edge computing for latency-critical geocentric applications, but satellite motion compresses line-of-sight communication windows to mere minutes. To maintain logical geographic proximity, a paradigm termed Virtual Stationarity (VS), applications must continuously migrate across passing satellites in the constellation. Traditional live migration mechanisms optimize individually initiated relocations or replication, but not the continuous handover between successive hosts that orbital motion requires. We reformulate live migration as a steady-state execution model and introduce a novel virtual stationarity runtime paradigm. We formalize the viability of continuous migration through a lightweight model capturing latency and availability service-level objectives (SLOs), continuous migration overhead, and the convergence bound of state replay. To satisfy these constraints, we derive a Virtual Stationarity Runtime (VSR) framework whose Migration Membrane combines Capability Virtualization and Continuous State Projection to rebind host resources and reconstruct evolving execution on a successor. item.title: Measuring the Energy Cost of Completing Tasks with Quantized Language-Model Agents
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 量化省内存与能耗，但现有研究要么在单请求上对比量化模型、要么在单一精度下测 agent——精度变化在完整 agent 任务上的能耗权衡从未被刻画。

方法 首次刻画本地部署 agent 的"任务级"量化能耗权衡：构建 29 个带自动 pass/fail 检查的 agent 任务（6 个家族，从单答案 SQL 分析到多步仓库 bug 修复），在裸金属 NVIDIA A100 节点上用 llama.cpp 测量两个开源模型 4-bit 与 8-bit 版本每输出 token 与每完成任务 的 CPU/GPU 能耗。

关键数字 29 个任务、2 个模型、4-bit/8-bit 两档精度、A100 裸金属实测；结果显示 4-bit 的能耗收益（摘要未给出完整数值结论）。

为什么值得看 量化收益的评估口径从逐 token 升级到任务级，agent 能耗评估方法论参考。

item.title: MLIPDiff: Guiding Denoising Diffusion Models for Structure-Based Drug Design via Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models have become a dominant approach to structure-based drug design.

Diffusion models have become a dominant approach to structure-based drug design. However, because they are trained primarily to fit reference structures, they often place ligands in physically implausible poses that clash with the protein. We introduce MLIPDiff, an inference-time guidance method that can be applied to pretrained diffusion models for ligand generation. The method uses physics-informed guidance from UMA (Universal Models for Atoms), a machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP). The guidance combines four weighted energy terms (protein-ligand interaction, ligand strain, steric clash, and pocket anchoring) and uses the original model checkpoint without retraining. On CrossDocked2020, MLIPDiff completely eliminates protein-ligand collisions while preserving the ligand's local geometry, improving bond-length distributions and physical plausibility relative to the base model. Compared to models such as NucleusDiff that are specifically designed to reduce atomic clashes, MLIPDiff achieves clash-free structures without compromising local geometry. It maintains the base model's PoseBusters pass rate and attains the best median Vina Score, Vina Min, and Vina Dock, surpassin…

item.title: LooseLeaf: Enabling Serverless GPUs for Computational Notebooks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Computational notebooks reserve a GPU for the whole session, yet the GPU computes only while a cell executes and sits idle otherwise.

Computational notebooks reserve a GPU for the whole session, yet the GPU computes only while a cell executes and sits idle otherwise. Serverless execution would release the GPU between cells, but reconstructing the accumulated notebook state on a fresh worker imposes substantial cost on every GPU cell. This paper presents LooseLeaf, a serverless GPU platform for interactive notebooks. LooseLeaf derives the state and import closures of each cell, the minimal variables and packages that the cell needs. Our analysis on 5,000 real-world notebooks shows that these closures are small, and user-cell editing leaves seconds to prepare them. LooseLeaf prepares a GPU worker with these closures while the user edits the cell. After execution, the worker saves the updated state within seconds, so the GPU is reclaimable after every cell. LooseLeaf starts 95-98% of GPU cells with no visible delay, matches the interactivity of a pinned session, and provisions 32-55% fewer GPU-hours than state-of-the-art notebook platforms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 Transformer 用更少参数做深计算；共享 KV 缓存的 LSTM 风格变体在并行训练与递归续读之间缓存条目失配，能否消除？

方法 宽度 1024 下共享 KV 缓存（持久缓存集从十五降到四），并行训练用标准注意力提供缓存条目、续读用共享注意力递归产生；在固定训练 token 预算最后 10% 用一致性损失对齐两趟训练的缓存条目。

关键数字 比 untied 控制少 40.4% 参数、前向 FLOPs 基本持平；FineWeb 三个宽度上消除 81-89% 的续读损失惩罚，两个训练种子在不相交文档上复现；四个宽度、1.05-4.19B token 下权重绑定的损失代价在低 token 预算时最小。

为什么值得看 循环权重+共享 KV 的低参数架构实证，数据与模型存储受限场景用循环计算换容量的参考。

item.title: KnitTrans: Coordinated Trajectory Transfer for Effective and Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training ...

Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training requirements can delay the admission of completed trajectories, resulting in higher architectural staleness: the additional parameter-version gap from disaggregated pipelining relative to colocated execution. Beyond admission, misalignment between data access and training consumption causes redundant movement and unnecessary waiting when transferring large trajectory payloads. We present KnitTrans, a system that coordinates the rollout-to-training path through three designs. First, constraint-preserving mini-batch admission allows flexibility in early mini-batch composition, while checking that enough capacity remains to satisfy the remaining quotas. Second, on-demand trajectory data access matches storage units to consumer assignments and overlaps micro-batch data preparation with computation. Third, multimodal encoding deduplication supports reuse across a mini-batch while preserving gradient contributions from all backbone micro-batches. Experiments show up to 93% lower architectural staleness than wit…

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persi...

Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. item.title: Information-Theoretic Scaling Laws for Generative Diffusion Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models trained on increasingly large datasets sampled from the same data distribution will converge to the same learned distribution.

Diffusion models trained on increasingly large datasets sampled from the same data distribution will converge to the same learned distribution. However, in practice, a model trained on finite data depends on the particular training dataset; this dependence is reflected in properties of the model's outputs, such as memorization and sample quality. To understand this dependence through an information-theoretic lens, we study \textit{model information}, a computationally tractable measure of how much samples from the trained model depend on the particular training dataset. We explore its scaling behavior as model size and training dataset size vary. Specifically, we uncover two qualitatively distinct scaling regimes: (1) a nonlinear model information regime marking the transition from pure memorization to imperfect generalization, and (2) a generalization regime characterized by linear scaling of the model information and progressively improved generalization and sample quality. We then posit an information-theoretically principled scaling law to quantify these two regimes, and show that this law yields induced scaling laws for memorization and sample quality. item.title: Inference-Time Prior Adaptation for Imbalanced Data Streams under Concept Drift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Data stream classification under concept drift and class imbalance requires models to adapt continuously while maintaining strong minority-class performance.

Data stream classification under concept drift and class imbalance requires models to adapt continuously while maintaining strong minority-class performance. Many existing approaches rely on active memory management, in- cluding instance removal, memory restructuring, resampling, and synthetic data generation. We present PAI-KNN, a k-nearest neighbor classifier that adapts via inference-time prior adjustment rather than memory modification. PAI-KNN main- tains a simple sliding-window buffer and dynamically adjusts its decision rule using class prior estimates derived from recent observations. Evaluated on a mul- titude of synthetic data streams covering various imbalance and drift scenarios, PAI-KNN achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods, per- forming particularly well under scenarios involving dynamic class imbalance and concept drift. These findings highlight the potential of inference-time adaptation in challenging non-stationary environments and suggest that adaptation in memory- based stream classifiers need not rely exclusively on memory modification.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: How AI Load Swings Reduce Datacenter Power Conversion Efficiency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

AI training and inference workloads make GPU power swing repeatedly between compute and communication phases.

AI training and inference workloads make GPU power swing repeatedly between compute and communication phases. As a result, the cascaded converters in a datacenter rack keep moving between operating points with different efficiencies. This paper uses an energy based, cycle averaged method to quantify that effect along a 240 V AC to 400 V DC to 51 V DC rack power path, using measured efficiency curves of commercially available GaN based PFC and LLC converters. For a 1 Hz, 50% duty-cycle load swinging between 5 kW and 510 W, conversion efficiency falls to 95.97%, compared with 96.82% at the equivalent constant average load, a loss of 0.88%. When 51/48V to 1V point of load conversion to the chip rail is included, it is shown that the loss grows to 1.66% (89.45% vs. 90.96%). These results show that efficiency rated at average load overstates real world performance, and that the penalty grows with each load dependent conversion stage between the grid and the GPU.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representat...

Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are frozen during long-context continual pretraining, suggesting that wider heads not only benefit updates in attention modules but lead to more effective adaptation of components such as embeddings and MLPs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GS-MoE: Training-Free MoE Compression via Groupwise Subspace Sharing and Pruning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 通过稀疏激活省计算，但专家参数存储仍是主要内存瓶颈——能否免训练地压缩 MoE？

方法 提出 GS-MoE，沿两个压缩轴处理专家间与专家内冗余：分组低秩表示捕获跨专家共享结构同时保留专家特定投影，Nyström 神经元压缩缩减专家内部宽度；用重建误差约简指导专家分组，用无梯度层重要性分数做层级预算分配，特征值与 leverage 再将其分布为组间非均匀秩与专家间宽度。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；实验显示两轴压缩在细粒度场景的高压缩率下收益互补。

为什么值得看 免训练 MoE 压缩的"跨专家+专家内"双轴方案，专家存储优化可参考。

item.title: From Parameter Rebasin to Functional Transfer Across Heterogeneous Transformers
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Adapting pretrained Transformers to downstream tasks produces task-specific updates that are expensive to reproduce for every model variant. Reusing these updates across different ...

Adapting pretrained Transformers to downstream tasks produces task-specific updates that are expensive to reproduce for every model variant. Reusing these updates across different depths and widths is challenging because their parameters have incompatible shapes and do not share a canonical coordinate system. We introduce Ariadne, a training-free method that transfers task-specific behavior across heterogeneous Transformers without resizing the source model or transporting its parameters. Rather than treating the source task vector, i.e. the difference in parameter space between the fine-tuned and the base models, as the object to move, Ariadne characterizes fine-tuning by the activation changes it induces at matched blocks. First, it aligns these effects to a target base through local Procrustes maps. Then, it directly synthesizes a native target update by closed-form ridge regression. Across Transformer expansion, reduction and language-model transfer, Ariadne improves target-model performance while substantially reducing the time and memory required to construct an update relative to previous cross-architecture rebasin approaches. These results show that local functional effects…

item.title: Embodied Emissions of 2.5D and 3D Scaling in Chipletized GPUs for Low-Carbon AI
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

GPU compute resources are scaling to support growing AI workloads, leading to further rises in the climate change impact of hyperscale data centers that rely on high-performance GP...

GPU compute resources are scaling to support growing AI workloads, leading to further rises in the climate change impact of hyperscale data centers that rely on high-performance GPUs. To model how packaging decisions impact the carbon footprint we have estimated the embodied emissions (EE) of a chiplet-based GPU that has been scaled in 2.5D and 3D using the imec.netzero modelling platform. We doubled the number of compute units and high bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity in the 2.5D and 3D scaled systems and found that 3D scaling results in an 89% increase in EE, as compared to an increase of 141% for 2.5D scaling, positioning 3D scaling as an attractive solution to limit the embodied emissions due to GPU scaling.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 集中式训练依赖少数巨头的数据中心，规模不可持续，也把持有私有数据但缺乏算力的小机构挡在门外——如何民主化 LLM 训练？

方法 围绕预训练与微调范式系统梳理分布式 LLM 训练路线：联邦学习、拆分学习与去中心化方法，评估其在异构硬件、不可靠连接的跨地域场景下的就绪度；提出统一系统架构——云托管参数服务器经出站 gRPC 协调异构客户端，预训练与一系列微调方法共用同一套通信、压缩与容错栈。

关键数字 在 GPT-2 Medium 与 Llama3-1B 上做真实跨地域实验验证设计（摘要未给出具体性能数字）。

为什么值得看 把边缘设备纳入 LLM 训练的完整系统综述+统一架构，边缘智能方向必读。

item.title: Data Quality Audit and Bivariate Temperature-Humidity Analysis of a Long-Term LoRaWAN Network: Anomaly Detection, PCA, Clustering and Machine Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Long-term environmental IoT/LPWAN deployments often aggregate heterogeneous data streams from diverse devices without systematic auditing of each variable's actual coverage prior t...

Long-term environmental IoT/LPWAN deployments often aggregate heterogeneous data streams from diverse devices without systematic auditing of each variable's actual coverage prior to analysis-an increased risk when multiple sensor types coexist within the same network. This work proposes a C++17 processing pipeline applied to the Tour Perret LoRaWAN dataset (421 937 frames, June 2021--June 2023, 5 devices). A systematic coverage audit integrated into the extraction phase reveals that CO2 is completely missing (0% coverage) and pressure is reported only by an isolated base module (Wyres, 4.24% of the corpus), invalidating the initial hypothesis of a joint four-variable analysis. The analysis is refocused on the Temperature--Humidity pair, jointly available across 205{,}005 frames (95.76%) from 4 Elsys EMS sensors. The pipeline sequentially performs anomaly detection (modified Z-score, Isolation Forest), bivariate Principal Component Analysis, clustering (K-means, DBSCAN), and a multilayer perceptron predicting humidity from temperature and time, whose residuals serve as a detector for slow drift. item.title: DRIVE: Fine-tuning via Data Contribution- and Diversity-aware Weighting with Prior Regularization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Single-stage fine-tuning is pervasive, yet catastrophic forgetting persists when the source pre-training data is inaccessible. Data weighting affords a natural lever to modulate sa...

Single-stage fine-tuning is pervasive, yet catastrophic forgetting persists when the source pre-training data is inaccessible. Data weighting affords a natural lever to modulate sample influence. Yet existing weighting methods lack a principled mechanism to explicitly arbitrate knowledge retention against new-task adaptation, and provide no unified differentiable objective to accommodate auxiliary signals such as sample diversity and sample characteristics. This is because current schemes privilege one goal over the other, and no explicit gradient-compatible encoding exists for such signals. To address this, we propose DRIVE, a principled and efficient weight assignment framework. It derives per-sample weights via a unified differentiable objective where three coupled signals co-evolve: Shapley additivity splits contribution into anti-forgetting and adaptation components, which are reshaped by a covariance-based diversity term and stabilized by a sample-characteristic prior. Far from a mere combination, this yields an end-to-end gradient-based scheme balancing stability against plasticity. Theoretically, we prove that DRIVE enjoys superior stability-plasticity guarantees over exist…

item.title: DIGOM: Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal healthcare data contain relational information that extends beyond individual patient observations. Effective clinical outcome prediction therefore requires not only int...

Multimodal healthcare data contain relational information that extends beyond individual patient observations. Effective clinical outcome prediction therefore requires not only integrating information from multiple modalities, but also modeling the relationships between them. Standard fusion approaches do not explicitly capture these interactions, while existing graph-based approaches typically model only a subset of them. We propose DIGOM (Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare), a graph-based framework that jointly models three complementary interaction types: Intra-patient cross-modal, Cross-patient same-modal, and Cross-patient cross-modal interactions. DIGOM learns a sparse multiplex graph with disentangled views, each encoding interactions between pairs of modalities across patients. Discrete adjacency matrices with patient-adaptive connectivity are sampled via a differentiable mechanism, enabling end-to-end learning and allowing the model to select informative relationships without imposing a fixed number of neighbors. A regularization objective maintains overall graph sparsity, while message passing integrates this relational context…

item.title: Controlled Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models: Random Initialisation, Band-Power and Validation-Selected Probes
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

EEG foundation models report downstream gains, yet their protocols seldom include three controls. These are the same encoder untrained, spectral features fitted on the same data, a...

EEG foundation models report downstream gains, yet their protocols seldom include three controls. These are the same encoder untrained, spectral features fitted on the same data, and a layer picked without looking at test scores. We therefore evaluate five publicly released EEG foundation models and an in-house JEPA-style model under one protocol with all three controls and several seeds, on five benchmarks and four added task families. The controls change the reading in three ways. First, picking the probed layer by its test score raises the layer-wise peak by an average of +0.034 and reverses the peak-versus-output gap in 9 of 36 cells. Second, with the layer picked on validation, random initialisation matches or beats pretraining for half of the models on sleep and emotion, and no model beats a five-band log-power baseline on emotion or motor imagery. Third, after full fine-tuning only 5 of 30 pairs gain beyond twice their seed spread, and the one clear loss of -0.290 AUROC persists under matched learning rates. From these results we draw four reporting practices, and we release every cell for re-analysis.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Bounding Queue Waits for Fair Scheduling of Bursty HPC Workloads via Hierarchical Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

HPC clusters are shared among many projects, each holding an allocation of node-hours, and ensuring fairness is becoming harder. Foundation models workflows and automated pipelines...

HPC clusters are shared among many projects, each holding an allocation of node-hours, and ensuring fairness is becoming harder. Foundation models workflows and automated pipelines have made job submissions bursty and concentrated among a few heavy users, so occasional users absorb queueing delays created by frequent ones, with no indication of how long their jobs will wait. Existing schedulers either forget past usage, protect only the job at the head of the queue, or assume that running jobs can be preempted. We propose HyDRA, a Hybrid Deadline and Ranking-Aware scheduler that enforces fairness among users while bounding the queue wait of every job. HyDRA assigns each job a deadline on arrival based on its size, the priorities of its project and user, the current backlog, and how far its project and user are from their entitled share. It ranks waiting jobs by a priority score that grows with waiting time, serves jobs close to their deadlines first, and backfills a job only when no deadline, or fairness limit is violated. We evaluate HyDRA on workloads derived from a year of ALCF Polaris job traces, against conventional schedulers and variants inspired by PCS, Themis, and the PBS …

item.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FP4 后训练量化（PTQ）在 Blackwell 原生 FP4 张量核上降低 LLM 推理成本，但仍有明显精度差距；SVDQuant 用高精度低秩校正弥补，但每 rank 位宽高、且与 FP4 GEMM 争用同一张量核。

方法 提出 BiLoCo：低秩校正的左右因子以 {±1} 二值符号向量存储而非 BF16——每个 rank-one 分量存储减少 16×，校正变成纯加减、可在 CUDA 核上与 FP4 张量核 GEMM 并发执行；在 B300 上实现为融合单 kernel。

关键数字 在 4B–72B LLM 上匹配或超越同内存的 SVDQuant。

为什么值得看 二值低秩校正把精度补偿的硬件开销压到极低，Blackwell FP4 推理落地参考。
