item.title: Beyond Hotness: High-Resolution Memory Characterization of Cloud and LLM Workloads for Tiered Memory with ARM SPE
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 云与数据中心内存成本飙升，多层内存（tiered memory）是平衡性能与成本的方案——但需要深入理解负载的内存行为才能用好它。

方法 面向数据中心日益增多的 ARM 处理器，基于 ARM 统计剖析扩展（SPE）实现高分辨率内存刻画方法：刻画 CloudSuite 与 LLM 应用中 8 个内存密集负载，识别区域特定访问模式，评估面向云的缓存层级有效性，并基于内存空闲期与延迟剖面提出新指标以决定分层内存的数据放置。

关键数字 覆盖 8 个内存密集负载（CloudSuite + LLM 应用）；摘要未给出具体性能数值。

为什么值得看 ARM SPE 实现的高分辨率内存画像，为分层内存数据放置提供方法论与新指标。

item.title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this wo...

Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. Across knowledge, mathematics, and code, \Method{} improves all five evaluated benchmarks for a 1.5B model trained on 240B tokens, averaging +7.84 pp over a matched direct mixture, including gai…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resour...

Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. Concretely, the methodology leverages failing assertions to guide the LLM in generating patches for multi-line bugs. Each candidate patch is formally verified using a model checker (JasperGold), ensuring only valid repairs are accepted. We evaluate the efficacy and scalability of our methodology on the BRISC-V RISC-V core using mutation testing, introducing several mutation types, and dem…

item.title: Amortized Thompson Sampling and Efficient Information-Directed Sampling for Simulator-Based Design
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Thompson sampling is a widely used strategy for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, offering a principled way to balance exploration and exploitation. This strategy invol...

Thompson sampling is a widely used strategy for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, offering a principled way to balance exploration and exploitation. This strategy involves maximizing a target objective under a single sample drawn from the current belief over unknown quantities. Conventionally, this optimization is performed once the belief has been inferred from data, and it becomes computationally burdensome when many Thompson samples are required, especially in continuous action spaces. In this work, we introduce an approach that amortizes this process ahead of time, before any data is collected, so that an approximation of the full Thompson sampling distribution is available immediately once observations arrive. We employ this approach to solve the multi-round setting, involving sequential data acquisition and Thompson-sample recommendation across rounds. Beyond accelerating Thompson sampling, our approach enables efficient estimation of expected information gain about the optimal action. This can be used to select more informative Thompson samples or to obtain maximally informative designs with optimization. Combining this estimate of expected information gain with …

item.title: All-in-One: A Composable Attack on LLM Transformations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Quantization, pruning, and model merging are popular transformations applied to deployment-ready LLMs to improve efficiency and downstream performance.

Quantization, pruning, and model merging are popular transformations applied to deployment-ready LLMs to improve efficiency and downstream performance. Recent work has shown that these transformations can introduce a security threat: an adversary can train a model that passes safety checks in its pre-transformed state, only turning malicious once it is transformed for deployment. However, prior attacks target one specific transformation (e.g., quantization) and generally rely on transformation-specific techniques, making them difficult to combine in practice. In this work, we introduce a simple, composable attack framework that targets multiple transformations simultaneously and triggers when any one of them is applied by a user. Our key insight is that the effect of each transformation can be approximated as a perturbation to the model weights, allowing us to jointly train the model with a benign loss on the original model and a malicious loss on each simulated transformed model. These perturbations are simple enough to simulate at every training iteration across diverse transformations, making them practically combinable within a single training objective, enabling a unified atta…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 不同应用有不同推理预算，但为每个预算单独训练维护模型成本高昂——能否一个模型支持多种推理深度？

方法 提出 Accordion，基于 MoE 的固定前缀层循环模型，支持五种推理预算：每个预算走预定义执行路径，最小预算保留无循环原模型；联合预训练每个 micro-batch 采样一个预算并优化其 next-token 损失，无需额外跨预算一致性目标；通过参数组融合与预算匹配的多教师在线策略蒸馏把三个领域专家整合进一个模型。

关键数字 3.6T token 预训练后，增加推理深度使 Accordion-6B-A0.5B 在 37 个任务上五类宏平均提升（摘要未给完整数值）。

为什么值得看 弹性深度推理的完整训练流水线（预训练+微调+RL），服务多预算场景可参考。

item.title: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU Direct Storage（GDS）三大局限：控制路径每次 I/O 都过内核、流有序路径强加全序、闭源用户态引擎难诊断难定制。

方法 uGDS 开源用户态 GPU Direct Storage 库：宿主机 CPU 在用户态管理整个 NVMe 命令生命周期，payload 走 PCIe P2P DMA 不占用 GPU 计算；统一跨厂商抽象（CUDA/AMD HIP）、负载感知调度、端到端透明；最小内核模块仅用于一次性特权设置。

关键数字 A100 + Samsung 990 PRO 上批量读带宽最高 12.12× GDS、批量写 30.69×；4KiB 同步写延迟降 84.1%；单流 5.49 GiB/s（GDS 仅保留 40.8%）；LMCache 中 TTFT 中位降 62.7%、goodput 提升 2.63×。

为什么值得看 开源 + 用户态 + 跨厂商，数据密集型 GPU 应用的实用加速层，已用于 LMCache。

item.title: When to Follow the Teacher: Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student.

Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. However, standard OPD trains the student to follow the teacher at every state of the trajectory, assuming that teacher guidance is always beneficial. We instead distinguish between what the teacher prefers and what actually helps the current student succeed. We introduce Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which weights teacher actions by their counterfactual advantage under the student. Teacher actions that improve the student's expected outcome are reinforced, while those that do not are downweighted. Directly computing these advantages requires trying alternative teacher actions at each step and running new rollouts from each. Instead, we show that the AOPD objective can be estimated using only standard student rollouts and their terminal rewards. Our estimator uses teacher importance weights on the student-sampled actions to provide unbiased advantage-weighted supervision, without any additional rollouts or reward evaluations. This allows AOPD to focus teacher supervision on actions that help the curren…

item.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication.

Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Forgotten Facts Return: Relearning-Aware Unlearning of Knowledge Graph Embeddings via Tangent Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Approximate unlearning answers a deletion request on a knowledge-graph embedding by editing entity embeddings instead of retraining from scratch.

Approximate unlearning answers a deletion request on a knowledge-graph embedding by editing entity embeddings instead of retraining from scratch. These embeddings keep being updated as new facts arrive. Under this ordinary continued training, forgotten facts recover more than in the exact-unlearning baseline, a model retrained without them and given the same continued training. We trace this relearning to entity embeddings shared by forgotten and new facts. To our knowledge, this is the first study of relearning in knowledge-graph embeddings. Relearning-robust methods developed for deep networks do not account for the graph structure underlying this recovery. We propose Kernel-Anticipated Unlearning (KAU), which uses the tangent kernel to model how continued training changes forgotten facts' scores through these shared parameters. KAU expresses this first-order response in closed form and differentiates through it inside the forgetting loss. The objective steers edits toward directions that continued training reverses less. We compare KAU with state-of-the-art knowledge-graph unlearners and relearning-robust methods under identical continued training, measuring leakage beyond the e…

item.title: Transformers with CoT Discover Heavy-Ball Acceleration Through Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Modern transformers often solve complex tasks by generating and refining intermediate reasoning steps.

Modern transformers often solve complex tasks by generating and refining intermediate reasoning steps. To develop a theoretical understanding of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, a notable recent study by Huang et al. (2025) viewed transformers as algorithm executors, and showed that when transformers' CoT steps are supervised by a gradient-descent teacher, they can learn to implement gradient descent for in-context weight prediction in linear regression. In this paper, we study the same in-context weight prediction task but ask whether CoT reasoning can go beyond merely imitating the teacher algorithm. We show that, after initial supervision from a gradient-descent teacher, further trajectory-level supervision using the true regression weights leads the model to implement the Heavy-Ball method, thereby achieving acceleration over the original teacher. Notably, this accelerated algorithm emerges without supervision from any Heavy-Ball teacher. Our results provide a concrete theoretical example in which transformer reasoning can discover new algorithms through training, rather than merely imitate the algorithm used for supervision.

item.title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck.

As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.

item.title: Tracing Subliminal Learning Through Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning.

Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. Wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) systems for construction worker human activity recognition (HAR) routinely report aggregate accuracies above 95 %, rarely under genuine subject-independent (le

Wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) systems for construction worker human activity recognition (HAR) routinely report aggregate accuracies above 95 %, rarely under genuine subject-independent (leave-one-subject-out (LOSO)) evaluation, masking the per-individual variance that determines real-world deployment performance. Using the VTT-ConIoT benchmark, we conduct, to our knowledge, the first systematic configuration sensitivity analysis of this dataset: six classifiers across five sensor placements and three window sizes under a single LOSO protocol, a personalised-calibration pilot, and a validated comparison of tabular GAN-based and standard time-series augmentation. Per-subject LOSO accuracy for the main multi-sensor, 16-class configuration ranges from 61.9 % to 88.7 % (mean 77.5 %), a 27 pp spread, though all data are laboratory-collected. item.title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently propo...

Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently proposed multigraph neural network architectures leverage this structure explicitly to achieve a strong performance on anti-money laundering (AML) tasks. However, their robustness to adversaries that manipulate transaction structures to evade detection remains largely unexplored. We present the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training of multigraph neural networks using node-edge incidence matrices, adapting projected gradient descent and projected randomized block coordinate descent methods to optimize structural perturbations over such matrices. We further introduce a cycle-based regularizer that penalizes changes in the global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles, providing a structural measure of attack plausibility. Experiments on synthetic pattern-detection and realistic AML datasets show that our learned attacks substantially outperform non-learnable perturbation baselines in reducing detection performance (PR-AUC), while adversarial training consistently improves robustnes…

item.title: Topological Equivalence of Spectral and Density Cluster Hierarchies
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We compare two canonical ways to recover hierarchical clustering from an underlying density $f$: the \emph{density cluster tree} given by connected components of superlevel sets $\...

We compare two canonical ways to recover hierarchical clustering from an underlying density $f$: the \emph{density cluster tree} given by connected components of superlevel sets $\{f\geλ\}$, and a \emph{spectral hierarchy} obtained by applying single linkage to diffusion distances induced by a Laplacian operator. We give conditions under which, at an appropriate diffusion time, the diffusion hierarchy is \emph{topologically equivalent} to the density cluster tree up to a monotone rescaling of heights. It further shows that a $k$-NN graph implementation inherits this equivalence from uniform approximation of diffusion distances, yielding a finite-sample reduction from spectral graph constructions to density-level-set topology.

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Tradit...

Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. item.title: SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system.

GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another. We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filte…

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositiona...

Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. Furthermore, two components make this high-quality at scale: Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), which supervises TEM's intermediate representations with a vision foundation model, and advanced sampling strategies that improve sample quality at inference. item.title: Same molecule, Different Knowledge: Cross-Identifier Binding Failures in LLMs For chemistry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge.

Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge. To test this assumption, we first introduce a controlled benchmark and show that it does not hold. Across foundation models spanning 7B to 72B parameters, even chemistry-specialized models, co-referring molecular identifiers consistently expose different subsets of the model's knowledge. We then conduct a series of controlled behavioral, representational, and causal analyses to characterize this failure. We show that even when a model can identify a molecule from its SMILES and retrieve a fact through the corresponding name, the same fact can remain inaccessible directly from SMILES. We term this phenomenon \emph{cross-identifier binding failure}. Further analysis of internal representations, conflicting identifiers, and parameter editing shows that neither improved chemical representation competence nor modification of individual facts is sufficient to establish reliable access across identifiers. Together, these results indicate t…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 格基向量量化在低比特 LLM 上有强率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍缺乏理解。

方法 SQuAT，shape-gain VQ-QAT：权重分解为方向与幅度，方向用 E8 派生球面码本量化、幅度用低比特标量量化器独立量化；方向与幅度使用分离的直通估计器，隐式产生切空间更新、实现球面（黎曼）优化；配分布式精确最近邻分配以支持扩展。

关键数字 VQ-QAT 训练时间降低 12.8×，可扩展到 10B token；在 LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-1.7B 上一致优于标准 VQ-QAT STE，达 SOTA 精度。

为什么值得看 首个将球面优化视角引入 VQ-QAT 的可扩展方案，附 12.8× 训练加速。

item.title: SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive.

Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. We show that the off-span norm implicitly selected by affine EI can lead to underexploration, and SABLE instead prescribes it using a finite-horizon schedule, without restricting search to a learned subspace. Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics. Neural-operator surrogates reduce inference cost after training, but their training data require the same expensive simulations they aim to replace, making data-efficient learning essential when only a few non-Newtonian simulations can be afforded. Here, we introduce the Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer (RheOPT), which pretrains a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tunes it on a small number of non-Newtonian samples. Rather than transferring the Newtonian constitutive response itself, RheOPT reuses geometry-conditioned transport structure that remains useful after the stress model changes. We evaluate RheOPT in two geometry-matched settings: a $4{:}1$ contraction channel for Giesekus, Oldroyd-B, and Bingham fluids, and the oscillatory wake behind a triangular obstacle for Oldroyd-B flow. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood.

Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood. In particular, the effects of two design choices remain unclear: Does access to the teacher's full action distribution provide an advantage over observing only the probability it assigns to the sampled action? Must training trajectories come from the student (online distillation), or can teacher-generated trajectories (offline distillation) suffice? Our work takes a first step toward understanding the theory underlying these questions. We study the sample complexity of online reverse-KL distillation under two feedback models: the teacher reveals either its full action distribution or only the probability of the student-generated action. We establish minimax bounds for the former and show that substantially more data may be required for the latter. In contrast, offline reverse-KL distillation can attain the same minimax rate whether the teacher reveals its full distribution or only its probability of the teacher-generated action. item.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 序列压缩是高效语言/多模态模型的关键信息瓶颈，但基于池化或学习投影的现有方法表现欠佳。

方法 测试时回归视角：输入 token 定义回归问题，拟合系数构成压缩表示；回归通过反向传播端到端学习，系数在前向中以闭式高效计算，形成 TTR-Compressor。

关键数字 块稀疏注意力上 RULER 性能大幅优于基于注意力的压缩器；视觉 token 合并持续胜过标准 MLP merger，且少用 55.6% 视觉 token 即达到相同性能。

为什么值得看 把序列压缩重新定义为测试时回归，为压缩器设计提供新原语。

item.title: Repair Changes Which Layers to Remove: Exact Optima for Depth Pruning of Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度剪枝中"移除哪些层"由启发式分数决定，其与最优选择的差距未知。

方法 精确评估所有层组子集（四个模型族约 53,000 个剪枝模型，含/不含 repair），发现最佳移除层取决于 repair：线性 repair 吸收相邻层交互，使最优布局从分裂式变为连续块；据此改为"在将应用的 repair 下选层"，贪心搜索成本与 SLEB 相同。

关键数字 相对 ReplaceMe，5 个模型（最大 27B）上困惑度降低 20%–66%；带任务目标时同数据下准确率高最多 25 分。

为什么值得看 首次给出深度剪枝最优层选择的精确基准，纠正"先选层再 repair"的普遍做法。

Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene.

Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene. In film production and high-end rendering pipelines, this technique computes global illumination, reflections, refractions, and soft shadows by tracing millions of light rays per frame and accurately modeling their bounces and attenuation. Contemporary GPUs incorporate specialized ray tracing hardware to accelerate key operations in the traversal pipeline. By accelerating these stages in hardware, the unit enables real-time ray tracing for complex scenes that previously required offline computation. However, ray tracing introduces substantial control and data divergence. Each ray may traverse a different set of nodes in the acceleration structure, encounter distinct materials, or terminate at varying depths. This irregularity reduces thread coherence and exposes a fundamental disparity between the GPU SIMT and per-thread execution model of dedicated RT units, where each ray progresses independently. item.title: Random Remasking Scales Masked Diffusion Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible.

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible. Recent work has shown that iterative correction can improve sample quality, yet existing theory fails to explain this given a learned, imperfect denoiser model. We re-formulate MDM inference as a Markov chain on the clean sequence space, defined by a remask-denoise kernel that randomly re-introduces masks and then denoises. This helps us analyze the actual denoising trajectory towards the data distribution. The analysis motivates Random Remask-Denoise (R$^2$D) inference, a purely test-time, finetuning-free, reward-free procedure. To further improve performance, we propose Trajectory Correction Training (TCT), a denoiser-training procedure that exposes the model to its own errors along the generation trajectory. On logical tasks, our approach exhibits a striking near-log-linear test-time scaling, achieving over 97% accuracy on hard Sudoku puzzles and over 99% accuracy on 3-SAT. Our approach also applies to pretrained models on actual language tasks, beating iterative correction baselines and the official Q-mode accuracy of LLaDA2.1-mi…

item.title: QuaNAS: Uncertainty-Aware Reuse of Earlier Searches for Query-Efficient Neural Architecture Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency.

Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency. Yet most NAS methods start from scratch, guided at best by zero-cost proxies that are unreliable across tasks. QuaNAS treats a library of earlier searches in the same search space as explicit knowledge of uncertain reliability. Main effects of design decisions learned from this library and, secondarily, zero-cost proxies become priors over candidate architectures without any label of the new dataset. A Gaussian process starts at the prior optimum and re-estimates after every evaluation how far each prior is trusted. Under a protocol frozen before any confirmation data were seen, QuaNAS was evaluated once on 12 new image, time-series, text and tabular datasets. It lowered anytime regret on the short-training objective 2.7- to 3.9-fold relative to five pre-specified NAS baselines that start from scratch (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0012 each). Its final models matched (non-inferiority margin 0.5 pp) or exceeded matched-recipe reference models on nine datasets, as did the prior optimum, selected without a single evaluati…

item.title: Pipelining vs. Combining in Aggregation Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study the aggregation task (convergecast) in networks in the case that the values to be aggregated do not fit in a single message.

We study the aggregation task (convergecast) in networks in the case that the values to be aggregated do not fit in a single message. We assume that every node starts with an input value, and there is an aggregation operator that is commutative, associative, and length-preserving, i.e., the result of aggregating two values has the same length as each of the input values. Since values do not fit in a message, they are transferred in a ``train'' of pipelined messages, which must be terminated whenever we want to aggregate values. The goal is to minimize the makespan time of aggregating all values. We present general lower bounds on the problem and optimal algorithms for several prevalent parallel computing architectures, including the hypercube and complete bipartite graphs, under both the splittable and unsplittable flows models. We also present an $O(\log n)$ approximation for general graphs in the unsplittable flows model.

item.title: OpenAttention: One Percent Is Enough with Tail Proxies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏注意力只读取 KV cache 的一小部分，未读尾部如何处理：直接丢弃会引入偏差，按采样处理在 5% 以下读取率时失效。

方法 关键观察：单 token 的 count-aware mean 代理即可折叠整个尾部；据此构建 OpenAttention 流水线（聚类 + ErrorGate + top-k 选择 + count-aware mean 代理），并设计训练无关的 Query-Geometry 聚类与选择器，ErrorGate 按各簇估计权重误差分配精确读取。

关键数字 RULER-32K HARD + Llama-3.1-8B 上 1% 读取保留 99% 稠密精度；定制 kernel 在 1% 读取时 decode 比稠密注意力快 10×。

为什么值得看 证明"1% 读取足够"，为极低读取率下的长上下文注意力提供新范式。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution.

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the resulting next-token distributions. We show that thi…

Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection.

Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection. Existing training-free approaches avoid task-specific optimization but primarily rely on predefined numerical scoring rules, leaving the semantic interpretation of heterogeneous anomaly evidence largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Jev-GAD, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework that bridges heterogeneous numerical evidence and pretrained decision mechanisms. To address heterogeneous anomaly patterns, we construct complementary structural, attribute, and neighborhood evidence and transform heterogeneous statistics into graph-relative anomaly percentiles. To move beyond predefined numerical scoring rules, we leverage a single frozen pretrained language model for evidence-conditioned anomaly assessment. To bridge the semantic gap between numerical evidence and pretrained models, we design a semantic Graph-to-State (G2S) transformation that organizes graph context and semantically labeled node evidence into structured decision states for non-generativ…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation.

On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures r…

item.title: Not All Retained Clients Are Equal: Client Selection for Federated Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Federated unlearning (FU) aims to remove a designated target client's influence from a trained model without the prohibitive cost of retraining from scratch. Existing methods large...

Federated unlearning (FU) aims to remove a designated target client's influence from a trained model without the prohibitive cost of retraining from scratch. Existing methods largely treat unlearning as a post-hoc, stateless operation, overlooking that client influence is path-dependent: contributions made during training, particularly during critical learning periods (CLPs), can have disproportionate and persistent effects. Moreover, knowledge overlap and intermittent client availability make relying on all retained clients inefficient and impractical. We introduce PDF, a path-dependent client-selection framework based on the insight that retained clients are not equally valuable for unlearning. During training, PDF maintains lightweight, target-agnostic, CLP-weighted histories summarizing each client's accumulated update direction and global-model alignment. Upon an unlearning request, these histories identify and rank retained clients that are globally informative yet weakly coupled to the target, enabling retraining-based unlearning with only the top-$k$ clients over a small number of rounds. Experiments on FMNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under IID and non-IID settings show tha…

item.title: Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation.

Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation. Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) provides such a heuristic, but scores projections independently and assigns identical scores to compatible reorderings of the same layer configurations. We introduce Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC) for Transformers, using a specification-derived statistical reference for accumulated residual updates to determine the input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, while retaining additive evaluation without data or instantiated weights. When residual widths vary, earlier choices affect later scores, so we augment NSC's allocator (NSC-DP) with residual history beyond its layer-and-budget state. ResNSC-DP jointly allocates residual and feed-forward widths under a resource budget, with certified bounds on the best numerically evaluated ResNSC score within a specified finite candidate set. At the 121M and 374M pretraining scales, selected architectures achieve lower mean perplexity than uniform, variable-width, and tapered allocations on FineWeb-Edu, WikiText-2, and LAMBADA at …

item.title: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE transformer 通过稀疏激活降低计算，但条件计算只发生在 MoE 算子中——能否在注意力算子侧也引入可与之嵌套的稀疏机制？

方法 提出 Nestor：一种类似 MoE 的注意力算子条件计算机制，其稀疏性与 MoE 算子的稀疏性自然嵌套（层级组合）；在同等计算量与稀疏度下与常规 MoE transformer 对比语言模型预训练，并评估持续预训练场景。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；结果显示 Nestor 在等计算等稀疏度下优于常规 MoE，且更适合持续预训练：能更有效地扩展到长上下文、更快适应新领域并对旧领域遗忘更少。

为什么值得看 把"条件计算"从 MoE 推广到注意力，可扩展预训练与持续学习的新结构方向。

item.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$?

Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MOER: Mix-Policy Optimization under Expert Prefix Guidance with Selective Rollback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL.

Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL. However, existing methods either provide static full-trace guidance that suppresses self-exploration, or adopt expert prefix guidance without correctness guarantees, leading to suboptimal performance or even training collapse. In this paper, we propose MOER, a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration. MOER injects a decaying expert chain-of-thought prefix into the prompt and lets the model complete the remaining reasoning, with the prefix length progressively annealed to encourage self-exploration. A selective rollback mechanism replaces failed completions with the original full expert trace, guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory. Furthermore, a harmonized mix-policy objective optimizes on-policy tokens with a GRPO loss while supervising both expert prefix and completion tokens with a trust-region SFT loss, substantially stabilizing training. Extensive experiments show that MOER achieves the highest average scores in mathematical and general domain reasoning ta…

item.title: Low-Latency MoE Inference in Space Data Centers: A Wireless-Power-Transfer Perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 太空数据中心以太阳能供电运行 MoE LLM，但专家激活偏斜导致供需不匹配：活跃专家受功率约束、空闲专家的采集功率被浪费。

方法 SpaceWPT 框架：用星间激光无线功率传输重分配采集功率；推导简化 WPT 控制的设计原则，以平均推理延迟的可处理代理刻画权衡，最小化得到双端 water-filling 策略，决定每个活跃专家捐出、保留还是接收功率。

关键数字 Mixtral-8x7B 与 Phi-3.5-MoE 模拟中推理延迟最高降低 29.25%，紧凑编队与高传输效率下增益更大。

为什么值得看 太空 LLM 推理这一新兴场景下的功率调度与延迟联合优化，思路新颖。

item.title: Local Discrimination of Binary Classifiers via Localized AUC Functional
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Risk prediction models are frequently evaluated with AUC, which means that during evaluation we are blind to performance heterogeneity, which could lead to bad decision-making in clinics.

Risk prediction models are frequently evaluated with AUC, which means that during evaluation we are blind to performance heterogeneity, which could lead to bad decision-making in clinics. In this work, we aim to change that by identifying patient cohorts for whom the risk prediction model might not be an accurate predictor. To separate these cohorts, we use a version of the weighted AUC, which we call Localized AUC or LAUC. Using this metric, we build a method that we coin LOCATOR. This method is able to identify cohorts of patients for whom the risk prediction model is inaccurate. We test this method both in real-world data and in simulations. We also build a statistical background for the use of Localized AUC for our purposes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Learning Structured Sparsity for Large Models: Bridging Model Compressibility and Efficient Inference
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 学习稀疏+低秩表示能让单 checkpoint 弹性压缩到多个内存预算，但参数量减少不等于推理变快——非结构化稀疏的索引开销与不规则访存会抵消计算收益。

方法 提出 S-SALAAD 统一框架，在训练中联合学习模型权重及其低秩与结构化稀疏分量；支持一族硬件兼容的结构化稀疏模式，将结构学习与预算感知压缩、专用 CPU/GPU kernel 结合，面向边缘设备本地部署。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体量化数字；核心主张是统一学习权重与结构可同时获得可压缩性与高效推理。

为什么值得看 直面"压缩≠加速"的部署瓶颈，结构化稀疏+低秩联合训练的端侧大模型部署路线。

item.title: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文 LLM 服务的 KV cache 超出 GPU/主机内存后，前缀检索把存储 I/O 推上推理关键路径——节点本地 NVMe 独扛所有检索，已挂载的并行文件系统/云文件存储几乎没有推理流量。

方法 提出 KVStream KV 缓存引擎，把前缀检索建模为跨存储层的聚合带宽调度：批量合并一步内的读、把写延迟到前向之后、每块在各层复制、空闲层自适应认领下一个未读块；性能模型显示该路由无需预测或调优即可达到聚合带宽上界，而任何静态切分都会因层带宽漂移而偏离。

关键数字 接入 LMCache 后在四个模型、六个数据集、最多 128 GPU 上评测，检索与最优方案的差距在 5% 以内（TTFT 增益随负载增长，主机内存或到达顺序保住复用时会消失）。

为什么值得看 给出多级存储下 KV 缓存检索的自适应调度方案，长上下文推理系统可参考。

item.title: Joules-to-GDP: How Much Economic Value Do AI Systems Produce per Unit of Energy?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes.

An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes. We therefore ask: How much economic value does an AI system create per unit of energy consumed? We formalize economic value in two ways: (1) net dollar value, the output's dollar value minus AI-system execution cost, and (2) time saving, the expert's completion time minus the AI system's completion time. Dividing each by measured end-to-end energy yields Net Value per Joule (NVJ) and Time Saving per Joule (TSJ), reported in USD/MJ and hours/MJ. We study 220 public GDPval tasks across 44 occupations, serving five open-weight models locally and evaluating four accelerator types. First, the occupation groups where AI systems succeed most often, deliver the greatest dollar value, or save the most time do not necessarily provide the greatest economic return per joule. For example, among the tested tasks, engineering work delivers about 10% more net dollar value per task than software development. Yet software development delivers about 27% more net value per joule. Second, GLM 5.2 delivers the highest average net dollar value, at $72.27 per task using 0.430 MJ, equivalent in …

item.title: Is spectral predictability enough? Testing Ω-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use.

Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use. A natural criterion is to match the spectral predictability $Ω$ of the source to the target, but is $Ω$ sufficient? We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds. Under ideal synthetic-to-synthetic conditions, $Ω$-matched pretraining can outperform even an oracle baseline (+46.8% MSE reduction, LSTM), though the benefit is already architecture-dependent. On the real-world ETTm1 benchmark, however, this relationship does not hold: sine-plus-noise pretraining at matched $Ω$ yields only a marginal mean improvement +2.3% averaged over all three architectures, up to +65.5% on individual channels), whereas $Ω$ matched chaotic ODE trajectories systematically degrade performance -13.2%). item.title: Is High Local Accuracy Enough? Geometric Consensus with Support-Adaptive Statistical Personalization for Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Real-world deployment of personalized federated learning (PFL) requires adapting to heterogeneous clients while preserving recognition performance beyond local distributions.

Real-world deployment of personalized federated learning (PFL) requires adapting to heterogeneous clients while preserving recognition performance beyond local distributions. However, high local accuracy can conceal failures on locally rare or absent classes. Effective personalization should therefore strengthen global recognition while raising the personalization floor. We propose an evaluation protocol that complements local accuracy with global, rare-class, and unseen-class evaluations to reveal generalization obscured by local scores, and assesses personalization floors among the worst-performing clients to expose weaknesses hidden by aggregate performance. To meet these deployment challenges, we propose FedGRC, a unified PFL framework integrating generalization and personalization through (i) Consensus-Guided Representation Learning (CGRL), which learns discriminative representations through shared directional and magnitude guidance; (ii) Multilayer Metric Synthesis (MMS), which constructs a shared covariance metric from these multilayer representations for statistical classification; and (iii) Support-Adaptive Shrinkage Personalization (SASP), which adapts class means within …

item.title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface.

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: HDLouvain: High-Throughput Incremental Clustering for Hyperdimensional Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines.

Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines. DBSCAN and hierarchical agglomerative clustering (HAC) offer flexible similarity search, but DBSCAN is unstable across varying data densities, HAC costs $O(n^2)$, and both yield poor cluster quality. Graph-based methods such as Louvain produce high-quality clusters but scale poorly on streaming data. We observe that Louvain's poor scalability can be resolved without sacrificing its quality, and present HDLouvain, which combines Louvain community detection with the bit-parallel similarity computation of hyperdimensional computing (HDC). HDLouvain partitions a bootstrap fraction of the stream into precursor-mass buckets, applies Louvain to each bucket's kNN similarity graph, and condenses each community into a single binary hypervector by bitwise-majority bundling rather than iterative centroid recomputation. New spectra are assigned by a GPU-accelerated Hamming distance lookup against representatives in their mass bucket, or seed a new cluster when no match meets a similarity threshold $τ$, so the partition grow…

item.title: Ground-Truth-First Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning via Converse Optimality: From Smooth, Fully Observed Systems to Non-Smooth or Partially Observed Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima.

Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima. Distance to optimality remains unobservable, while conclusions may depend on reward design, stochasticity, hyperparameters, environment selection, and simulator details. We develop a ground-truth-first framework based on converse optimality, constructing each task with a certified optimal value function and policy withheld from learners and used only for evaluation. The framework unifies two modes: sensitivity benchmarking samples certified environments from continuous-time generators to assess robustness to task variation, while oracle-referenced comparison uses native discrete-time generators to evaluate policies via optimality gap, regret, and policy error. Continuous-time models support physically interpretable sensitivity studies but introduce dependence on the simulator step ($Δt$) and numerical scheme. Native discrete-time models align the environment, oracle, and learner on the same transition law, eliminating external integration choices as a confounder. We reproduce quantitative results covering optimizer sensitivity and oracle-referenced compa…

item.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 服务用 SSD 扩展 KV cache 容量，但多轮对话与 agent 等生产负载的 KV 写入总量远超 SSD 容量，寿命从数年缩短到数月。

方法 Gandalf，首个 SSD 寿命感知的 KV offloading 系统：仅按历史访问模式门控写入会伤命中率——不同注意力类型的 KV 可能访问模式相同但未来模式不同；Gandalf 据此优先把 full-attention KV 准入 SSD。

关键数字 平均延长 SSD 寿命 7.3×，缓存命中率影响可忽略；设计可扩展到 High Bandwidth Flash 等闪存。

为什么值得看 把应用层注意力类型纳入 KV offload 决策，直面生产级闪存磨损这一真实成本问题。

item.title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance.

Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. This decomposition yields a principled scoring rule to rank token-level guidance. We combine this with a progressive \textbf{coverage annealing} schedule that shrinks the budget of tokens…

item.description:

Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval.

Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. item.title: Federated Differentially Private Optimization via Low-Rank Preconditioning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models.

We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models. Existing central DP methods for covariance estimation have communication cost that grows quadratically in the data dimension, while existing baselines with linear communication cost are only locally private and degrade as the number of clients increases. As a remedy, we propose a federated DP-PCA framework that achieves linear communication cost while providing central DP guarantees under secure aggregation. It consists of a DP rank selection step, a DP power method, and a noisy release of the covariance projected onto the selected low-dimensional subspace. We give error bounds for this covariance estimate and for the resulting low-communication preconditioned DP gradient descent. Empirically, our proposed DP optimization method matches a centralized baseline with quadratic communication cost at a fraction of the communication.

item.title: Fast Path, Exact Path: One Library of Hardwired Operators for Streaming and Exact Canny Edge Detection on a Low-Cost FPGA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Hysteresis edge tracking, the final stage of Canny edge detection, follows edge chains of unbounded length and therefore resists single-pass streaming; FPGA ...

Hysteresis edge tracking, the final stage of Canny edge detection, follows edge chains of unbounded length and therefore resists single-pass streaming; FPGA designs either approximate it or dedicate separate labelling hardware to it. We show that a single library of hardwired 3x3 operators, each with an identical two-clock latency, delivers both a camera-rate approximation and exact hysteresis on a low-cost Artix-7 (XC7A35T). The fast path streams camera pixels through the operators and K local hysteresis stages and commits each edge decision 262.15-720.63 microseconds after the pixel arrives (K = 1-8; system simulation with a datasheet camera model), that is, 3 + K camera lines later and 46-127x sooner than a frame-based processor can even begin at 30 frames per second. It provably never reports an edge that exact hysteresis rejects, recovers 76.6-96.1% of exact edges at thresholds 20/40, and on the 200 BSDS500 test images retains at least 98.6% of the exact path's boundary F-measure (ODS 0.470-0.477 versus 0.476). item.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Per-Layer Embeddings（PLE）占 Gemma 4 E4B 参数的 35.2%，需要极端压缩；常规量化在如此压缩率下每个 token-层向量只有几字节码字。

方法 OPTIC：每个 token 只存一个量化码元组，每层用层专属仿射解码器解码；码与解码器拟合 PLE 输出路径而非存储向量本身。

关键数字 约 100× PLE 压缩（BF16 E4B）保留 97.8% 聚合性能（最强的产品量化基线仅 66.3%）；594×/1002× 压缩保留 90.5%/84.1%；W4A16 版 100× 压缩保留 96.9%；推理时 GPU 显存少 29.7%，速度最多慢 0.40%。

为什么值得看 把量化范式从"逐 token 逐层各配码字"翻转为"token 共享索引码"，极端压缩率下损失极小。

为什么值得看 把量化范式从"逐 token 逐层各配码字"翻转为"token 共享索引码"，极端压缩率下损失极小。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization.

In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization. In federated clustering, each round reveals additional model information to the server and can increase the opportunity to infer properties of local datasets, even when raw samples are never shared. Consequently, fewer client-server exchanges and unlinkability are important, so transmitted information cannot be attributed to any single client. Data-stream clustering algorithms, which learn in a single pass over the data, align well with the one-shot federated learning paradigm, where a single communication round can be sufficient. The proposed Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering (eFDPC) method combines evolving fuzzy data-stream clustering and density peak clustering in a federated setting. Each client independently evolves micro-clusters from private data mini-batches through cluster addition and merging. To limit communication, density peak clustering is applied to the learned micro-clusters and only the selected peaks are transmitted, rather than the full local models. A shuffler-based layer is introduced between the clients and the…

item.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Apple Silicon 是最广泛的本地 LLM 推理平台之一，但几乎所有推理优化都在服务器级 NVIDIA GPU 上设计与验证——哪些优化迁移后仍有效？

方法 评估四类优化（KV cache 剪枝、推测解码、移植 GPU kernel、后训练量化），覆盖 4 台 Apple 机器，并在可比条件下对照 RTX 4090。

关键数字 KV 剪枝在 Apple 上端到端吞吐最高 1.75×，但在桌面 NVIDIA GPU 上反而降吞吐；全部推测解码方法在 Apple 上降吞吐（服务器 GPU 上报 2–6× 增益）；可移植 kernel 组件最高带来 1.20× decode 吞吐。

为什么值得看 结论"加速不是技术本身的便携属性，而是技术×运行时×硬件契约×负载的联合函数"，对端侧优化有直接指导。

item.title: Energy-Aware Performance Characterization of Kokkos Kernels Across Precision Levels
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 加速 HPC 应用中，FP32/FP64/混合精度如何影响核的算术强度、吞吐与 GPU 能耗？

方法 对两个应用的 Kokkos 核做精度级刻画：引入能量感知 Roofline 模型把能耗纳入性能分析，提出热感知核间能量模型将能耗与时长、GPU 温度、执行顺序一并可视化；采用 Kokkos Performance Tools PAPI 连接器的应用级细粒度插桩，以及厂商电源管理组件的专用核基准粗粒度 PAPI 插桩两种方式。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；结论是精度影响随应用、核与负载而异——混合 FP32/FP64 核通常达到接近 FP32 的算术强度、吞吐略降、多数情况能耗小幅增加；FP64 核能耗普遍最高。

为什么值得看 把能耗纳入 Roofline 分析框架，为 HPC 精度选型提供可复用的刻画方法论。

item.title: Energy and Latency First: How Deployment Constraints Reverse Time-Series Model Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时序模型通常按精度排名，但真实部署存在排名不包含的硬约束——蜂窝网络切换预测要求每 40ms 测量周期内完成推理，且能量是设备寿命级的累计预算。

方法 按尾部而非均值筛选 deadline 可行性，再对可行模型按实测推理能量排序，并计入前向传播前的特征计算成本。

关键数字 梯度提升树 F1=0.974 且运行成本最低；精度基准会排第一的 CNN-1D（F1=0.914）在真实 duty-cycled 部署下每次推理能耗高出 3 倍以上。

为什么值得看 证明精度导向基准不仅低估部署成本，还可能把无法部署的模型排第一；并给出可推广到电信之外的三个条件。

item.title: End-to-End Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning for Physics-Informed Optimization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimizat...

Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimization (MBO), methods must improve designs using only a fixed dataset and no test-time access to the true objective. However, existing methods typically suffer from conservatism, unconstrained surrogate exploitation, or function as static inference-time samplers that cannot refine candidates against precise physical objectives. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning (D2C) for offline MBO, which leverages the fact that deterministic sampling makes the reverse denoising chain differentiable with respect to the conditioning signal. D2C turns a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer by directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogate objectives and physics-informed penalties backpropagated through the reverse chain. We implement this idea in a composed proposer-evaluator framework and evaluate it on laser pulse optimization for inertial confinement fusion, sustainable data-center workload scheduling, and f…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient and Optimal Learning of Discrete Distributions with Person-Level Privacy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting.

We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting. Given $n$ users, each contributing $m$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $μ$ over $[k]$, we seek an estimate of $μ$ with total-variation error $α$. We give polynomial-time algorithms under both pure and approximate differential privacy. Under pure $(\varepsilon,0)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k/\varepsilon)$, the first polynomial-time pure-DP guarantee matching the information-theoretic optimum up to logarithmic factors. Under approximate $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k+\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$. At $δ=2^{-Θ(k)}$, this is $\widetilde O(k)$ for fixed $α,\varepsilon,m$ and failure probability. Our algorithms use a new degree-6 sum-of-squares estimator for learning from untrusted batches. Its key ingredient is a trace-bounded diagonal majorizer for the difference between the empirical covariance of the repaired batch averages and the multinomial covariance predicted by their mean. We prove that clean data admit this certificate through semidefinite-programming duality and a new …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Omni 多模态大模型推理成本高，但不同查询对额外模态的收益不一——固定模态配置是否低效？

方法 研究查询级（query-wise）模态选择：保持底层 Omni-LLM 不变，为每个查询自适应选择提供哪些模态；将问题形式化为精度-成本优化，提出成本敏感的学习方法。在 WorldSense 上用 Qwen2.5-Omni 与 Qwen3-Omni 评估三种推理成本口径：输入 token、延迟与货币成本。

关键数字 Qwen2.5-Omni 上成本敏感选择达到或超过全模态精度，输入 token 仅需约 41%。

为什么值得看 不做模型改动、仅按查询裁剪模态即可改善精度-成本权衡，多模态服务降本可借鉴。

item.title: Effectiveness of Curriculum Learning Depends on Reward Sparsity and Competing Optima
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

While animals and people tend to learn a task more quickly and reliably when they first train on simpler versions of it, curriculum learning's effectiveness in artificial settings ...

While animals and people tend to learn a task more quickly and reliably when they first train on simpler versions of it, curriculum learning's effectiveness in artificial settings varies, and appears substantially greater in reinforcement learning than in supervised learning. In this work, we construct and analyze a minimal model of policy learning to better understand why. We consider an open-loop, episodic target interception task whose parameters---especially how close the agent must be to the target to receive an informative reward signal---can be chosen so that the agent either receives informative rewards frequently ('dense' rewards) or rarely ('sparse' rewards). We mathematically and numerically analyze the dynamics of REINFORCE-based policy learning in both cases. In the dense reward case, curricula have only marginal benefits; in the sparse case, curricula can be required for learning to occur at all. We find that this is especially true when the agent has the conflicting goals of minimizing effort and accumulating high reward, since this can produce distinct reward landscape optima which compete with one another. Our characterization of useful curricula in this setting in…

item.title: EGGPlacer: Energy-Guided Generative Chip Placement with Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Chip placement strongly affects routed wirelength and thermal behavior, yet these downstream metrics are difficult to evaluate during macro placement.

Chip placement strongly affects routed wirelength and thermal behavior, yet these downstream metrics are difficult to evaluate during macro placement. Learning-based macro placers commonly optimize the macro-only half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL), denoted mHPWL, which ignores standard cell connectivity and spatial demand. In contrast, analytical mixed-size placers optimize differentiable full netlist wirelength and density objectives but are typically unaware of thermal effects. We propose EGGPlacer, an energy-guided diffusion framework that incorporates analytical placement feedback and thermal feedback into macro placement generation. An analytical placer acts as an online physical response model, exposing the standard cell distribution and a full netlist wirelength proxy induced by each intermediate macro placement, while a differentiable thermal model provides temperature feedback. These signals are formulated as composable energies and injected throughout reverse diffusion without retraining the underlying generative model. Experiments on public placement benchmarks show that EGGPlacer achieves competitive mixed-size HPWL relative to strong analytical and learning-based macro p…

item.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 多模态 LLM 长形式生成中，KV 压缩通常在 prefill 一次性选定视觉 token 并全程复用，但生成过程中模型读取的证据持续移动，one-shot 选择严重受限。

方法 RCR：由漂移决定何时/何处重选，每样本控制器调节重选频率；配合低秩漂移检测器、候选受限重选与 GPU 上决策，单一设置适配所有模型与任务。

关键数字 6 个 model-task 设置中 5 个比逐部检索的 InfiniGen 高 1.6–3.8 ROUGE-L，距精确逐步重选仅差 1.7 分；GPU 驻留检测器小 4×；DetailCaps 上漂移定时比随机定时高 2.0–5.0 分。

为什么值得看 指出"固定漂移阈值"系统性失效并给出按样本预算调控的可迁移方案。

\emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. item.title: Decode Late, Multiply Once: Rethinking the Dot Product for Quantized Weights
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 1-4 bit 量化权重的神经网络推理中，点积仍按每元素一次乘法计算——能否把乘加（MAC）大幅压缩？

方法 提出"延迟解码、一次相乘"重构：长度为 n 的点积只需 n+2^k 次加法、至多 2^k 次解码与 2^k 次乘法；每个权重码直接作为地址偏移选择 2^k 个累加器之一，累加结果最后统一做融合的解码-相乘，解码后的权重向量从不显式成形。对整数算术精确成立，支持整数/浮点操作数与非线性解码器，可扩展到分组缩放与矩阵/张量积；配套设计 SA-PE 处理单元替换脉动阵列中的 MAC。

关键数字 乘法次数降为原来的 n/2^k 分之一；总算术能耗改善受成本模型量化的有界因子约束。

为什么值得看 从算法层面重构量化点积的运算结构，对低比特推理硬件设计有直接参考价值。

item.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage.

Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-sh…

item.title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequen...

Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequences often suffer from semantic inconsistency--exhibiting redundancy or conflicts within and across modalities--which hinders robust understanding and increases computational cost. To this end, we introduce ConsMSA, which explicitly formalizes semantic distribution consistency across both $\textit{intra}$- and $\textit{inter}$-modality, providing a consistency-aware mechanism for robust and efficient multimodal sentiment prediction. Specifically, ConsMSA projects multimodal token features into a shared sentiment space to compute an Intra- and Inter-modality Consistency Score ($I^2CS$). By coupling this score with predictive relevance, we formulate consistency-aware importance signals that are utilized: (i) as a consistency regularizer to align latent distributions during training, (ii) to derive semantic-aware weights for adaptive multimodal token reweighting, and (iii) as a practical criterion to prune redundant or conflicting tokens. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS demonstrate t…
